Its product families span roaming management (traffic steering, GlobalRoamer, campaign management), risk management (revenue assurance and fraud detection via RAID), network security (cross-protocol signaling firewalls and SMS/voice protection), testing and service assurance (5G, eSIM, IoT, VoLTE testing, dsTest), customer experience, and data insights and monetization. Mobileum sells primarily to carriers as deployed/managed enterprise software and does not publish a public developer portal or open API surface.

companies.name: SambaTV
companies.description: Samba TV is a media and advertising intelligence company that measures television and streaming viewership across screens using data collected from millions of opted-in smart TVs and connected devices. Its platform gives advertisers, agencies, and publishers cross-screen audience targeting, campaign measurement, and content analytics built on privacy-first, deterministic viewing signals rather than cookies or traditional identifiers. Samba TV operates a gated partner portal (developer.samba.tv, which redirects to partner-portal.tvp.samba.tv) for licensed data partners; as of this enrichment pass it does not publish an open, public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or MCP server.

companies.name: Sentisis Analytics
companies.description: Sentisis (Sentisis Intelligence) is a Spanish-language AI consumer-intelligence and sentiment-analysis platform that turns social media conversations, surveys, emails, and online reviews into actionable business insight using proprietary natural-language-processing built for Spanish and its regional variants. Products span Social Media listening, Customer Experience analytics, Reviews analysis, and sector consulting, serving brands such as Vodafone, Santander, Bancolombia, ALDI, Iberdrola, and Sony Pictures from offices in Madrid, Bogota, and Mexico City. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a domain security probe.

companies.name: Statespace
companies.description: Statespace is the company behind Aimlabs (aimlabs.com, formerly statespace.gg), the leading AI-powered aim-training platform for FPS gamers. Aimlabs delivers personalized training tasks, real-time performance analytics, and game-specific tools, serving over 40 million players and operating as an official partner of Valorant and Rainbow Six Siege. Statespace is venture-backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Lux Capital. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a consumer web/desktop product but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: StatMuse
companies.description: StatMuse is a natural-language search engine that answers sports and financial questions in plain English, returning instant stats, tables, and visual answers. It covers MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL, WNBA, PGA, college football, and soccer, along with StatMuse Money for stock-market and finance data. Users ask questions conversationally ("How many points did LeBron score last night?") and get sourced answers with charts and shareable cards. Backed by Techstars, the company is consumer-facing and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or programmatic access surface; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company lead.

companies.name: str8bat
companies.description: str8bat is a Bangalore, India based sports-technology company that builds a pocket-sized IoT sensor which attaches to a cricket bat and captures batting metrics in real time — bat speed, impact speed, back-lift angle, timing, sweet-spot placement and a 360-degree view of every shot. The sensor pairs with the str8bat mobile app (iOS and Android) to deliver instant, visual and actionable insights plus an AI cricket coach. The company reports 30,000+ active users, 6+ million shots recorded and operations across 350+ Indian cities and 14+ countries. str8bat is a consumer hardware and mobile-app company and publishes no first-party developer API; its str8bat.com storefront runs on Shopify, which exposes standard commerce discovery surfaces (customer-account OIDC and a Universal Commerce Protocol agent-commerce MCP endpoint).

companies.name: Time is Ltd
companies.description: Time is Ltd. is a collaboration analytics company that turns workplace communication and productivity data into actionable insights for HR, sales, and operations teams. Its platform connects to tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Webex, and Tableau to measure meetings, focus time, and collaboration patterns, then reports on team performance, employee engagement, and revenue outcomes. Backed by Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network, Time is Ltd. exposes no public developer API; integrations are configured through its hosted analytics application rather than a documented REST or GraphQL surface.

companies.name: Helu Io
companies.description: helu.io is a financial management, controlling, and reporting platform for startups and small-to-medium businesses. It connects directly to DATEV accounting data (via a certified DATEVconnect interface) to produce automated, real-time financial reports, customizable dashboards and KPIs, budget vs. actuals comparisons, multi-entity consolidation, and planning, so finance teams can analyze, plan, and collaborate without manual spreadsheet work. The company is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and hosts data on German servers in compliance with DSGVO/GDPR. helu.io is a SaaS product; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI — its integrations are product-level (DATEV, plus data upload from HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Excel, and Personio).

companies.name: Reserv
companies.description: Reserv is an insurance technology company and third-party administrator (TPA) that combines AI-powered automation with human claims expertise to handle property and casualty (P&C) claims for MGAs and carriers across North America, the UK, and the EU. Its platform pairs adjuster workflows with analytics dashboards, reporting, and structured claims data, positioning itself as the simplicity of a TPA with the benefits of an in-house team. Reserv is backed by 8VC, Anthemis, and Bain Capital Ventures. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

companies.name: Bedrock Data
companies.description: Bedrock Data (Bedrock Labs, Inc.) is a data security posture management (DSPM) company that helps organizations discover, classify, and control sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments. Its platform is built on a unified Metadata Lake that combines data sensitivity, lineage, identity and access entitlements, and data-flow analysis, layered with AI-driven classification and a natural-language policy engine, and a zero-data-access architecture in which analysis runs where the data already resides. Bedrock advertises a Graph API (GraphQL) and MCP integration surface for downstream security tooling such as SIEM, Wiz, Sysdig, and Jira, though no public developer documentation or OpenAPI is currently available. The company is backed by Greylock.

companies.name: DocSend
companies.description: DocSend is a secure document sharing and analytics platform, now part of Dropbox, used by sales, marketing, and fundraising teams to share pitch decks, sales collateral, and confidential documents through trackable links. It provides page-by-page viewer analytics, granular access controls (email verification, passcodes, expiration, watermarking), virtual data rooms, and e-signature. DocSend was surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures, DCM Ventures, and Uncork Capital and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Enrichment confirmed a live, OAuth-secured hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at mcp.docsend.com backed by RFC 8414 authorization-server discovery, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), and PKCE.

companies.name: One Data
companies.description: One Data is a German enterprise software company (onedata.ai, formerly onedata.de) whose AI-native platform transforms legacy and fragmented enterprise data into trusted, governed, AI-ready data products. Its capabilities span metadata management, data quality assurance, data-product lifecycle management, SAP BW migration optimization, process-mining foundations, and sovereign data management for public-sector organizations. One Data is certified to ISO 27001:2022, ISO 9001:2015, and TISAX, and is a portfolio company of HV Capital. As of this enrichment pass One Data publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, developer portal, or GitHub organization — its customer portal and documentation are authentication-gated.

companies.name: Scuba
companies.description: Scuba (Scuba Analytics, formerly Interana) is a real-time behavioral and customer analytics platform for self-service exploration of large-scale event data, backed by Battery Ventures and DCVC. The company is rebranding to Behavure AI and extending its behavioral query engine to detect drift, explain decisions, and govern AI agents across models, systems, and users. Scuba publishes product user guides, admin guides, a glossary, dated release notes, and a Tableau connector at docs.scuba.io (now docs.behavure.ai), but does not currently expose a public developer REST API reference, SDKs, or machine-readable API specification.

companies.name: Twaice
companies.description: TWAICE (TWAICE Technologies GmbH) is a Munich-based battery analytics software company. Its predictive analytics platform turns BMS data from battery energy storage systems (BESS) and electric-vehicle fleets into actionable insights for performance management, warranty management, safety monitoring, digital commissioning, and BESS reporting, alongside a battery simulation model library for engineers. Customers include BESS asset owners and operators, IPPs, utilities, automotive and bus/truck OEMs, and battery manufacturers. TWAICE is ISO 27001 certified, holds the automotive TISAX label, and is backed by investors including Creandum and Speedinvest. It publishes no public API or developer program; the platform is a closed SaaS.

companies.name: Actifio
companies.description: Actifio is an enterprise data management company that pioneered "copy data management" (CDM) built on its Virtual Data Pipeline (VDP) technology, letting organizations capture a single physical copy of production data and instantly provision virtual copies for backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, test/dev, and analytics. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, Actifio was acquired by Google Cloud in December 2020. Its technology now underpins the Google Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery (Backup and DR) service and Actifio GO, delivering SaaS backup and DR for Google Cloud and hybrid workloads. Actifio VDP exposes automation via a RESTful API and CLI on the appliance, but there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger specification, or published client SDK.

companies.name: Forterro
companies.description: Forterro is a pan-European industrial software company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, that provides enterprise resource planning (ERP) and specialised business software to the industrial mid-market. Built through a series of acquisitions, Forterro operates a portfolio of regional and vertical ERP brands - including Abas, Jeeves, Garp, Proconcept, Sylob, Silog, Myfactory, Orderwise, Clipper, 123Insight, BPSC, Helios, Proffix, Prodaso and its cloud-native Fortee product - alongside best-in-class point solutions such as warehouse management (WMS), point of sale (POS), material requirements planning (MRP) and business intelligence. The company serves more than 13,000 industrial businesses across manufacturing, warehousing, wholesale and retail from 40+ offices worldwide.

companies.name: VOYGR
companies.description: VOYGR provides real-world place intelligence for AI apps and agents, delivering continuous location and point-of-interest (POI) data validation and enrichment. Its Location Freshness Validation confirms historical existence and current operating status, detecting relocations, rebrands, and closures across multiple attributes with up to 99.62% validation precision and configurable decision thresholds. Its Location Data Enrichment populates and continuously enriches place records from web, social, authoritative, and other sources, spanning foundational attributes (address, contacts, web presence), operating data (hours, menus, prices), and fresh context (articles, reviews, news, events). VOYGR is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) and SNR.VC backed seed-stage company based in San Francisco, founded by Vlad Baskakov (CEO, ex-Google Maps) and Yarik Markov (CTO, ex-Google/Meta/Apple ML). Its maps API goes beyond the 10-15 standard attributes of existing mapping providers. The developer surface is currently demo-gated and no public API documentation is published yet.

companies.name: Zoomin
companies.description: Zoomin is a content and knowledge orchestration platform that unifies unstructured product content — documentation, in-product help, knowledge base and community answers — into personalized self-service and in-app experiences across customer support, success and experience teams. Founded in Tel Aviv, Zoomin was acquired by Salesforce on November 1, 2024 and now powers the Unified Knowledge and Agentforce/Data Cloud offerings. Its products include the Content Delivery Platform, Documentation Portal, In-Product Help, Zoomin for ServiceNow, Unified Knowledge and Zoomin Analytics. Zoomin does not publish a public, self-serve developer API surface; its integrations are delivered through customer implementations and the Salesforce platform. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company.

companies.name: Apiday
companies.description: Apiday is an ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) software platform built for private markets. It combines AI-powered automation with expert guidance so investors, fund managers, and portfolio companies can streamline sustainability reporting, comply with regulatory frameworks (SFDR, EU Taxonomy, EDCI, PRI, ILPA), automate ESG questionnaires and due-diligence requests, calculate GHG emissions against 3,000+ benchmarks, and turn ESG obligations into measurable value creation. The company reports that over 500 investors and 5,000 companies use the platform across private equity, venture capital, private credit, institutional LP, and infrastructure asset classes. Backed by Speedinvest. Apiday does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures the company's identity and public web surface.

companies.name: Opolskie Open Data
companies.description: Opolskie Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Poland running DKAN.

companies.name: Theom
companies.description: Theom is a cloud Data & AI Operations Center that governs and secures enterprise data estates, providing automated data security, compliance, and safe generative-AI data activation across multi-cloud environments. Founded in December 2020 by former Cisco, Google, and Yahoo security practitioners (creators of Tetration Analytics), Theom detects active data breaches, maps real-time data lineage, analyzes identity-aware data usage and insider threats, and enforces data-usage policy agentlessly. Its product spans Theom Core (data security and lineage), Theom AI (GenAI leak prevention), and Theom Trust (real-time data contracts). Theom is backed by Wing Venture Capital, Ridge Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, Databricks Ventures, SentinelOne Ventures, and M12, and was named a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave for Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification. Theom is delivered as an enterprise platform; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API docs.

companies.name: Zurich Open Data
companies.description: Zurich Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Switzerland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 925 datasets.

companies.name: Avant-Garde Health
companies.description: Avant-Garde Health is a healthcare data analytics company that helps hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), and physicians identify cost-reduction and quality-improvement opportunities in surgical care. Its CareMeasurement platform ingests electronic medical record (EMR), financial, and patient-reported outcomes data, combines it with claims data and proprietary algorithms, and applies time-driven activity-based costing (TDABC) so care teams can drill into clinical, financial, and operational detail, benchmark performance across departments and institutions, and drive value-based improvement. Products span surgical cost management, surgical coding optimization, surgical quality and outcomes optimization (ERAS), PACU and OR throughput, and CMS TEAM support. Surfaced as a General Catalyst portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

companies.name: Clarium
companies.description: Clarium is a healthcare supply chain resiliency company founded in early 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and headquartered in New York City. Its AI-powered platform, Astra OS, unifies real-time data from hospitals and their suppliers across systems of record, then layers data-enabled workflow apps on top: Disruption Monitoring to detect and resolve supply chain disruptions faster, Substitute Management to automate product approvals, and Procedure Card Optimization to standardize and cut cost. Clarium has raised $43M+ (including a $27M Series A led by General Catalyst, with Northzone among its backers) and works with leading health systems such as Mount Sinai, Ochsner Health, Allina Health, and Yale New Haven.

companies.name: Jaspersoft
companies.description: Jaspersoft is a business intelligence and embedded analytics platform, now part of Cloud Software Group (formerly TIBCO). Its flagship products are the open-source JasperReports Library — a Java reporting engine (net.sf.jasperreports) — and JasperReports Server, a reporting and analytics server that exposes a REST API (rest_v2) for managing the repository, running and scheduling reports, executing queries, and administering users, roles, and organizations. Developers embed Jaspersoft content into their own applications with Visualize.js and the js-visualize component library, and interact with the server programmatically through official Java and PHP REST clients. Sector: data analytics / business intelligence. Backed by Sapphire Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

companies.name: TVbeat
companies.description: TVbeat is a London-based, Techstars-backed advertising technology company whose platform unifies linear television and streaming (CTV) advertising operations into a single system. It lets media owners and buyers forecast, plan, transact, optimize, and measure campaigns across audiences, yield, and operations, supporting multi-currency transacting (ratings, spots, impressions, and outcomes) and modern buying models — Direct, Programmatic, Self-Serve, and AI-driven — across both traditional linear spots and streaming inventory. TVbeat does not publish a public API, SDK, or open developer portal; its documentation portal at docs.tvbeat.com is private and requires credentials.

companies.name: SkySpecs
companies.description: SkySpecs is a renewable energy asset management company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan that combines autonomous drone inspections, condition-monitoring hardware, and its cloud-based Horizon software platform to help wind and solar operators manage the health and performance of their assets. Horizon consolidates blade inspection imagery, drivetrain and sensor data, SCADA-based performance analytics, repair-vendor coordination, and financial reporting into one hub, with third-party data ingestion and custom integrations for fleet owners. The company reports assets under contract across six countries and is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management. SkySpecs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or self-serve developer portal today; integrations are arranged directly with the Horizon team.

companies.name: UrbanMetry
companies.description: UrbanMetry is a Malaysia-based big data analytics firm specialising in geospatial and urban intelligence for the property and real estate sector. It supports developers, financial institutions, government bodies, retailers, and public transport operators with property market intelligence, geo-behavioural analytics, and branch location analysis, alongside consumer products UrbanVault (multi-bank mortgage applications, in beta) and UrbanWave (home co-ownership and renovation funding). A World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, UrbanMetry publishes no public developer API, but its website exposes a live Wix Site MCP endpoint and llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

companies.name: Vespucci
companies.description: Vespucci (Vespucci Analytics) is a product-analytics platform that helps teams understand why their users engage with a product. Rather than replacing existing analytics, it connects to the event data companies already collect in Amplitude or Segment (via Reverse ETL) and applies statistical and AI models to automatically surface the drivers of activation, retention, churn, and engagement. It provides 24/7 monitoring with automated alerts when behavioral patterns shift, user segmentation, and story-style dashboards, and can push identified segments to activation tools such as OneSignal, MailChimp, and Brevo. Founded in 2021 and based in Brussels, Belgium, Vespucci is backed by Seedcamp.

companies.name: Incentivio
companies.description: Incentivio is a Boston-based digital guest engagement platform for multi-unit restaurant brands, unifying online ordering, loyalty, marketing automation, and guest analytics into a single system. Its Incentivio Connect product is an AI-powered, API-first restaurant data platform that ingests data from POS, loyalty, mobile apps, web, and marketplaces, resolves it into a single persistent Guest ID, and scores guests for lifetime value, churn risk, visit frequency, journey stage, propensity-to-purchase, and offer sensitivity. The platform is BigQuery-native with a Star Schema data model, SOC 2 aligned with encryption at rest and in transit and RBAC, and pairs an API-first surface with reverse ETL to sync unified guest records back to existing CRM and ad platforms. Incentivio is built on modern APIs and offers deep partner integrations with POS, payments, delivery, and marketing systems such as Toast, Oracle Simphony, Square, SpotOn, and PAR Brink. Public, self-service developer API documentation does not appear to be available; integration and API access are handled through partnerships and enterprise onboarding (the Connect Enterprise tier markets dedicated API SLAs).

companies.name: SequoiaDB
companies.description: SequoiaDB (巨杉数据库) is a distributed, document-oriented NoSQL database built for financial-grade workloads and widely deployed across banking, insurance, securities, and government systems in China — running in production at more than 100 banks. A single cluster scales to 500 physical servers, 3.0 PB of storage, and 1.4 trillion rows, with remote disaster recovery targeting RPO=0 and RTO under 15 seconds. The platform is multi-model: a native distributed storage engine with full ACID transactions, a MongoDB-protocol-compatible document store (dds) with built-in vector indexing for AI workloads, a MySQL-compatible SQL engine (SequoiaSQL-MySQL), and an S3-compatible object interface (SequoiaCM). The core engine is open source under Apache-2.0, and access is provided through native client drivers for Java, Python, C, C++, PHP, and C#/.NET rather than a public HTTP REST API. SequoiaDB is backed by DCM Ventures and Qiming Venture Partners.

companies.name: AlgoX2
companies.description: AlgoX2 is a data streaming operating system that unifies ingestion, ordering, fan-out, transformation, and durable storage into a single fault-tolerant engine, positioned as an alternative to assembling Kafka, Flink, and Redis. Built by veterans of NYSE Pillar's matching engine, the platform offers a partition-free API, compute-storage separation, a zero-copy runtime, and native multicast fan-out, with native support for Kafka, NATS, MQTT, Redis, HTTP, and WebSocket protocols and protocol bridging between them. Streams automatically materialize as Apache Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi tables in S3-compatible Parquet storage for lakehouse integration. AlgoX2 raised a $3.5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and serves real-time use cases including exchange and matching-engine infrastructure, market-data distribution, risk and surveillance, backtesting, and AI feature streaming.

companies.name: Bayes Impact
companies.description: Bayes Impact is a nonprofit organization that builds open-source AI and data-science tools for public services, governments, and nonprofits, with a mission to empower people in need and those who help them. Surfaced through Y Combinator, it has served over 10 million beneficiaries across three continents. Its flagship open-source project, Bob (formerly Bob Emploi), delivers personalized, data-driven career and job-search advice to jobseekers through a Python/Flask RESTful JSON API whose data structures are defined in Protocol Buffers. Other projects include the Bayes Platform agent framework for public services, the Encompass geographic-access analysis tool, and a range of civic data-science tooling.

companies.name: Dgraph
companies.description: Distributed graph database with a native GraphQL API, automatic type enforcement, real-time subscriptions, horizontal scaling, and built-in authorization directives.

companies.name: Kissmetrics
companies.description: Kissmetrics is a product and behavioral analytics platform that tracks individual user activity across web and mobile, surfacing funnels, cohorts, retention, and revenue reports tied to identified people. The platform helps product, marketing, and growth teams understand user journeys and pinpoint conversion drop-off. Kissmetrics provides REST APIs for querying reports, exporting segments, and ingesting events, authenticated via HTTP Basic auth.

companies.name: Pienso
companies.description: Pienso is an interactive no-code AI and machine learning platform, founded in 2016 out of MIT by Karthik Dinakar and Birago Jones and headquartered in the Washington, DC / Arlington, VA area. It lets subject-matter experts explore, train, fingerprint, annotate, and deploy deep-learning and large language models over unstructured text — customer calls, emails, documents, and social content — through a point-and-click interface with no coding required. Product capabilities include Ingest, Train & Fingerprint, Annotate, Dataset Analysis, and PromptFactory, applied to use cases such as customer insight, content moderation, document intelligence, and risk detection. Pienso is deployed into the customer's own environment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Gcore, or on-premises — so data never leaves the customer's control, and the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; integration is sales-led and the platform runs as a self-contained system. Backed by Uncork Capital.

companies.name: PostgreSQL
companies.description: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open-source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development that has earned a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance. It supports advanced SQL features, JSON, full-text search, custom data types, extensions, and transactional DDL. PostgreSQL does not expose a native HTTP REST API; client applications connect via the libpq C client library, JDBC, ODBC, or one of dozens of language-specific drivers using the PostgreSQL wire protocol (default port 5432).

companies.name: Wiser
companies.description: Wiser Solutions is a retail and commerce intelligence company that provides pricing, market, and MAP (minimum advertised price) intelligence to brands and retailers. Its platform collects online and in-store data, tracking billions of products daily across hundreds of thousands of stores, to power price optimization, competitive price monitoring, promotion and assortment tracking, review analytics, and unauthorized-seller enforcement. Wiser serves hundreds of brands and large retailers and integrates with major eCommerce platforms and marketplaces. As of this profile Wiser publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through its platform, dashboards, and partner connectors.

companies.name: Avantos
companies.description: Avantos is an AI-native operating system for client management in financial services, built for wealth management and advisory firms. The platform unifies client data, products, teams, and workflows into a knowledge graph that powers agentic onboarding, relationship intelligence, and an AI-powered servicing workspace where agents anticipate client needs and streamline operations. It integrates with existing CRMs, custodians, and core systems, and is SOC 2 compliant with enterprise-grade architecture. Avantos raised a $35M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, announced February 2026.

companies.name: Condor Energy
companies.description: Condor Energy is an AI-powered energy management operating system for enterprise energy procurement, built for industrial companies, retailers, and data center operators who buy electricity at scale. The platform aggregates consumption data, PPAs, solar, batteries, and live market data into real-time dashboards; models load against market dynamics to execute hedging strategies and produce board-ready price-risk reporting; and analyzes granular load data to find flexibility opportunities and evaluate ROI on solar, battery, EV-charging, and hybrid investments. Founded in 2026 by former electricity traders and energy physicists, the Paris-based company is a Y Combinator Winter 2026 company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published as of this profile.

companies.name: Texas Capital Bank
companies.description: Texas Capital Bank, National Association is the banking subsidiary of Texas Capital Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBI), a Dallas-headquartered full-service financial services firm founded in 1998 with roughly $31.5 billion in assets (FYE 2025). As a nationally chartered commercial bank it serves businesses, entrepreneurs, and institutions across Texas and the United States with commercial and business banking, treasury management, mortgage/warehouse finance, and investment banking. On the open-finance dimension the bank is relationship-first rather than developer-first: it markets treasury and ERP API integrations (including its ConnectNow embedded banking for Sage and NetSuite, direct platform integrations, and SFTP/XChange file transfer) but exposes them through partner onboarding with dedicated bankers, not a public self-serve developer portal. There is no public first-party developer portal, no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger, and no self-serve API signup. Consumer account and transaction data is made available to permissioned third parties through the Finicity (Mastercard) aggregator rather than a first-party API, which is the honest posture for most US regional banks under the voluntary, fragmented US open-banking landscape (CFPB Section 1033 and the industry FDX standard).

companies.name: AGTools
companies.description: Agtools, Inc. is an agricultural technology (AgTech) company providing a real-time data analytics and market-intelligence SaaS platform for the global food supply chain. The platform aggregates and curates hundreds of official government, institutional, university, and weather data sources covering 450+ specialty crops and commodities across 189+ countries, exposing 70+ variables and 25+ years of historical records (pricing, supply, demand, exchange rates, weather, CO2 footprint, and transportation costs) through dashboards, daily commodity reports, and a price analyzer so growers, shippers, buyers, and retailers can forecast demand, manage purchase orders, and reduce food waste. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, California, Agtools is a Techstars Farm to Fork alumnus and Microsoft Machine Learning & AI award winner. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface has been published to date.

companies.name: Auquan
companies.description: Auquan builds production-grade, autonomous AI agents for institutional finance — agentic systems that convert messy, global, unstructured data (earnings calls, ESG disclosures, filings, news across 2M+ sources in 76 languages) into auditable, decision-ready intelligence and fully-formed deliverables such as credit memos, IC memos, portfolio-monitoring alerts, sustainability reports and LP reporting. Its RAG-powered agents cover 550,000+ companies and entities and complete end-to-end workflows autonomously for banks, asset managers, private credit, insurers and other institutional clients. Founded by Chandini Jain (CEO) and Shub Jain (CTO) with offices in New York and London, Auquan is used by 40% of the top 50 financial institutions (MetLife, T. Rowe Price, BC Partners) and was named a Gartner 2025 Cool Vendor in Agentic AI. The platform is demo/sales-gated and publishes no public self-service API or developer portal.

companies.name: Bedrock
companies.description: Bedrock (Bedrock Ocean Exploration) builds advanced autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and Mosaic, a cloud-native data platform that transforms how the world maps, monitors, and understands the seafloor. Its AUV fleet carries multibeam echosounder, side-scan sonar, magnetometer, and sub-bottom profiler payloads to deliver high-resolution geophysical survey data for offshore energy (wind, oil and gas, renewables), ports and harbors, submarine telecom infrastructure, defense, and scientific research. A Northzone portfolio company, Bedrock is an enterprise ocean-data provider; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

companies.name: Columbia Bank
companies.description: Columbia Bank is an Oregon state-chartered commercial bank and the principal banking subsidiary of Columbia Banking System, Inc. (NASDAQ: COLB), a West Coast regional bank holding company headquartered in Tacoma, Washington with more than $50 billion in assets. The bank took the legal name "Columbia Bank" effective July 1, 2025, having previously operated as Umpqua Bank following the 2023 merger of Columbia Banking System and Umpqua Holdings Corporation. On the open-finance front, Columbia is one of the relatively few US regional banks to run a first-party developer surface: Columbia API Banking, a commercial and treasury-management integration product exposing capabilities such as book transfers, ACH file imports, positive pay, stop-payment and NSF management, lockbox management, transaction and statement search, check images, and real-time account balances in JSON and XML, backed by a production-ready SDK and the gated Columbia API Portal. That surface is commercial/ERP-oriented rather than a self-serve public developer portal, and consumer-permissioned data access is instead delivered through the Plaid aggregator. No documented FDX participation or published CFPB Section 1033 posture was found.

companies.name: Flovision (formerly FloWaste)
companies.description: Flovision Solutions (formerly FloWaste) builds AI-powered computer-vision systems for food production, using cameras and machine learning to measure product on the line for yield improvement, quality control, and staff-performance tracking. Its FloVision Nano (conveyor measurement, KPI reporting, and benchmarking) and FloVision Pro (real-time operator guidance at processing stations) products feed a hosted FloVision Analytics dashboard, and the company reports processing over 23 million kg of food and recovering up to 1.5% of production yield. Insight Partners portfolio company in the manufacturing / food-tech sector; no public developer API or documentation surface has been published to date.

companies.name: Optoscale
companies.description: Optoscale (OptoScale AS) is a Norwegian aquaculture technology company founded in 2015 in Trondheim that builds AI-powered, camera-based edge-computing monitoring for fish farming. Its Bioscope units capture real-time measurements of fish weight, biomass, sea-lice counts, welfare, behaviour and feeding, producing tens of thousands of validated measurements each day directly on the unit rather than on remote servers. Customers view trends, graphs and high-resolution imagery through the OptoScale web portal, export to Excel/CSV, and integrate the underlying data into their own analytics and farm-management systems via OptoScale's data API. OptoScale was acquired by Insight Partners in 2025.

companies.name: LAMMA Toscana Open Data
companies.description: LAMMA Toscana Open Data is a government agency open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 184 datasets from Tuscany's meteorological and environmental research agency.

companies.name: ATB Financial
companies.description: ATB Financial (formerly Alberta Treasury Branches) is a financial institution and Crown corporation wholly owned by the Government of Alberta, established in 1938 and operating under the provincial ATB Financial Act rather than the federal Bank Act. Headquartered in Edmonton, it is Alberta's largest home-grown financial institution and the largest public bank in North America, with roughly C$64 billion in assets, more than 800,000 customers, about 5,000 team members, and 300+ branches and agencies across the province; deposits are guaranteed by the Province of Alberta rather than covered by CDIC. On the open-finance front, ATB does NOT operate a public first-party developer portal or documented public API surface (developer.atb.com returns HTTP 404), and Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking framework (legislated in Budget 2024 and the Fall Economic Statement 2024, with the FCAC as overseer) is not yet operational. Consumer financial-data access to ATB today is therefore voluntary and aggregator-mediated — reached through third-party aggregators such as Finicity (by Mastercard) and Flinks rather than a direct bank API.

companies.name: Forged Sports, Inc.
companies.description: Forged Sports, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California software company (founded May 2024) building a Venue Management System (VMS) for commercial indoor golf and golf-simulator venues. The platform consolidates bay operations, bookings, player profiles, waivers, leagues, business intelligence, and third-party integrations into a single command center — offering live bay monitoring, reservation and booking management, player-retention analytics, game-popularity insight, and bay-utilization reporting. Forged Sports also develops gamified indoor-golf experiences on top of launch-monitor technologies. Backed by 500 Global. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface is currently published.

companies.name: Haber
companies.description: Haber (Elixa Technologies Private Limited), headquartered in Pune, India with a US presence in Chicago, is an industrial AI company delivering AI-led automation for smart manufacturing across heavy industries including pulp, paper, packaging and tissue, metals and mining, food and beverages, oil and gas, and water/utility institutions. Its product suite spans eLIXA, an IIoT-powered process intelligence platform; Mt. Fuji for historical data storage, visualizations, digital twins and predictive interventions; Kaiznn, an optimization engine for trim-loss reduction, inventory and production scheduling; plus Kensei and FiMorph. The platform emphasizes real-time monitoring, predictive analytics, and enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022). Surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: MDClone
companies.description: MDClone is a healthcare data company whose ADAMS platform gives health systems, life-sciences organizations, and researchers self-service access to explore, analyze, and share clinical data. Its signature capability is a synthetic-data engine that generates non-reversible, artificially created datasets which preserve the statistical characteristics and correlations of real patient data without carrying any protected health information (PHI), removing re-identification risk. The platform lets users organize source data, generate synthetic versions on demand, run analytics, and apply generative AI to accelerate research and improve patient outcomes. MDClone is enterprise/customer-gated: access, support, and any programmatic data-export API are provisioned to licensed customers rather than published as a public developer program.

companies.name: Arc Simulations
companies.description: Arc Simulations is a London-based sports technology company, founded in 2022 by Henry Smith and Michael Armenakis and part of the Techstars London Spring 2024 accelerator cohort. Arc builds ball-tracking and simulation technology for cricket and other ball sports: professional-standard cricket balls carry embedded tracking tags that transmit position data to sensors up to 200 times per second, feeding a real-time simulation and analytics platform. The system predicts ball trajectory post-impact from velocity, angle and spin to deliver millimetre-accurate, autonomous feedback for every shot, with customisable field configurations that mirror live match scenarios. Arc serves players, coaches, scouts, analysts, broadcasters and fans through a hosted application (app.arcsim.io) and a player-facing app (player.arcsim.io) offering ball-by-ball 3D simulations. Arc's technology is built first for cricket but is designed to track nearly any sports ball. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and web/security posture in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Daash
companies.description: DAASH is an AI-powered predictive commerce intelligence platform built specifically for the beauty and cosmetics industry. It combines consumer shopping panels covering 6M+ people with social and advertising trend data and enriched product attributes to estimate sales performance, market share, and emerging trends at the SKU level. DAASH delivers weekly competitive intelligence to beauty brands, manufacturers, and financial services firms so they can uncover category shifts, benchmark competitor performance, and spot growth opportunities. The company was founded at the intersection of predictive intelligence and consumer products by retail and data experts (Philip Smolin, CEO; Justin Stewart, CTO; Melissa Munnerlyn, CMO), and is a portfolio company of Bullpen Capital. DAASH is delivered as a hosted SaaS application (my.daash.co); it currently exposes no public developer API surface.

companies.name: Pillar Technologies
companies.description: Pillar Technologies provides construction jobsite risk management through environmental monitoring and data analytics. Its wireless, rugged "Pod" sensors measure eight environmental metrics on the jobsite (temperature, humidity, carbon monoxide, VOCs, particulates, noise, light, and pressure) with cellular connectivity and a one-year battery life, feeding a real-time software platform with customizable dashboards, floorplan integration, and drill-down reporting by site, floor, or sensor. A configurable alert system notifies teams via text, email, or phone. Pillar serves data centers, hospitality and multi-family housing, and science and healthcare construction projects to improve safety and protect schedules and budgets. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: QPLIX
companies.description: QPLIX GmbH is a Munich-based wealth management software company offering QPLIX-Q, an all-in-one SaaS platform for professional investors, family offices, asset managers, and banks to consolidate, manage, and report on multi-asset-class portfolios. The platform automates portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, accounting, tax, and client reporting, integrating direct data feeds from 150+ custodian banks (UBS, Julius Baer, Deutsche Bank, and others) and leading market-data providers (LSEG, Moody's, S&P Dow Jones Indices, ISS ESG). QPLIX runs a self-hosted, API-based infrastructure on ISO 27001-certified European data centers, holds an ISAE 3402 attestation, and is registered with Germany's BaFin as an account information service provider (AISP). The company does not publish a public developer API or portal; integrations are delivered as managed add-ons and there is no OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

companies.name: Slintel
companies.description: Slintel is a B2B sales and market intelligence platform that mines buyer and technographic signals — company firmographics, technology installs, psychographics, and buying-intent scores — to help revenue teams prioritize accounts and time outreach. Founded in 2016 and backed by Accel and Sequoia, Slintel was acquired by 6sense in 2021 and its data and API services are now consolidated into the 6sense Revenue AI platform. Slintel's programmatic surface (company identification, firmographics, lead scoring, and enrichment) is delivered through the 6sense API Portal rather than a standalone Slintel developer portal; this profile reflects that consolidation and captures the surviving public developer surface.

companies.name: Branch8
companies.description: Branch8 is a digital solutions and managed contracting company headquartered in Hong Kong with operations across Asia (Singapore, Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines). Founded in 2015, it provides managed technical squads and blended onshore/offshore teams that deliver e-commerce implementation (Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, and marketplace operations on Shopee, Lazada, and Amazon), CRM and CDP strategy (Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, mParticle, Braze, Dynamics 365), digital product and mobile engineering, AI and workflow automation (n8n, Make, Windmill), and data engineering (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran). Branch8 serves mid-market to enterprise clients including Chow Tai Fook, Chow Sang Sang, Lacoste, Hong Kong International Airport, Hotai/Toyota, and HKBN. It is a services firm rather than an API producer and publishes no public developer API, but it does expose an agent-native llms.txt describing its services.

companies.name: CrownIT
companies.description: CrownIT (Crownit.in) is India's online market-research and consumer-insights platform, now acquired by Ipsos, the world's leading market research company. Operating as a full-stack agency, Crownit conducts online surveys and tracks purchase and consumption behavior via shopping bills and product photos submitted through its mobile app, applying machine learning and big-data analytics to deliver fast, accurate and comprehensive consumer insights to over 200 brands and enterprises across 40+ Indian cities. Backed by Accel and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio company profile; Crownit runs a consumer rewards and survey application rather than a public developer API, so this profile carries company identity only and has no OpenAPI, developer portal, or API artifacts.

companies.name: David AI
companies.description: David AI is an audio data research company building high-quality speech and conversational datasets to bring AI into the real world through voice. Using a rigorous six-step research process (hypothesize, design, experiment, evaluate, productionize, release), the team produces datasets such as Converse (channel-separated two-speaker English conversations), Atlas (multilingual data spanning 15+ languages with dialect and accent metadata), Chorus (multi-speaker conversations for speaker separation and diarization), and Dialog (expert domain conversations). Its data is licensed to Fortune 100 companies and research labs working on speech recognition, translation, synthesis, and conversational AI. Access is arranged through samples, consultation, and a data license agreement rather than a self-serve API. David AI is backed by Amplify Partners. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

companies.name: Dualbird
companies.description: Dualbird is a data and AI infrastructure company building accelerated data processing systems that speed up Apache Spark and Amazon EMR workloads by 10x-30x at 50%-90% lower cost, without code changes or migration. Founded by Gilad Tal (CEO), Ohad Gamliel (Chief Engineer), and Ehud Eliaz (Chief Hardware Architect) - a team with deep ASIC, FPGA, and high-performance computing expertise - Dualbird optimizes enterprise data pipelines at the hardware and software level to remove processing bottlenecks and let organizations maximize data utilization beyond current GPU capabilities. The company raised a $25M round backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Uncork Capital. As of this enrichment pass Dualbird publishes a marketing and company site only - no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or GitHub organization were found.

companies.name: Flagstar
companies.description: Flagstar Bank, N.A. is the OCC-chartered national bank subsidiary of Flagstar Financial, Inc. (NYSE: FLG), the Hicksville, New York holding company formerly known as New York Community Bancorp (NYCB). It is one of the largest regional (super-regional) banks in the United States, formed when NYCB acquired Flagstar Bancorp in December 2022, converted Flagstar Bank, FSB into a national bank (Flagstar Bank, N.A.), and subsequently acquired certain assets and liabilities of Signature Bridge Bank from the FDIC in March 2023; the holding company rebranded to Flagstar Financial in October 2024. Flagstar operates in retail and commercial banking, mortgage origination and servicing, and warehouse lending. On the API front, Flagstar runs a first-party developer portal at developer.flagstar.com (a Broadcom/Layer7 "LivePortal" API Developer Portal), but as of this review it publishes no public, self-serve API products, API documentation, or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger to anonymous visitors — all products are sign-in gated behind partner/consumer-team access. Flagstar has no publicly documented FDX (Financial Data Exchange) participation or CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture; consumer-permissioned data sharing appears to be available only through third-party aggregators (e.g. Plaid, Tink, TrueLayer) rather than a first-party public API.

companies.name: Fundamental
companies.description: Fundamental (Fundamental Technologies Inc.) is an AI company building foundation models for tabular data and enterprise decision-making. Its flagship product, NEXUS, is a Large Tabular Model pre-trained on billions of real-world enterprise tables that learns which patterns drive which outcomes and delivers predictions with a single line of code. Founded by DeepMind alumni and serial entrepreneurs, the company raised a $255M Series A in February 2026 and is backed by Kindred Ventures. It targets predictive analytics across financial services and other enterprise sectors. Fundamental publishes no public API or developer platform yet, so this profile is an identity record rather than a spec-bearing API.

companies.name: Fundamental Technologies
companies.description: Fundamental Technologies Inc. (Fundamental) is an AI company building foundation models for predictive decision-making across enterprises and governments. Its flagship product, NEXUS, is a large tabular model pre-trained on billions of real-world enterprise tables and designed to capture the complex, non-linear feature interactions in structured data that large language models handle poorly. NEXUS is positioned to be deployed "with just one line of code" with a deep AWS integration and confidential-computing privacy controls. Founded by DeepMind alumni and led by serial entrepreneurs, the company raised a $255M Series A in February 2026 and is surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Battery Ventures portfolio company. As of this profile it publishes a marketing and research presence at fundamental.tech but no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Gridwise
companies.description: Gridwise is an earnings-tracking and optimization platform for rideshare and delivery gig workers, aggregating mileage, trip, and income data across gig platforms such as Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Grubhub, Instacart, and Amazon Flex so drivers can see where they earn most and drive more strategically. Alongside the consumer app, Gridwise operates Gridwise Analytics, a B2B mobility-data business that turns millions of anonymized driver location, trip, and earnings records into industry benchmarking, KPI, and market-intelligence products for gig mobility platforms, financial services, retailers/merchants, and autonomous vehicle fleets. Data is delivered as aggregated weekly reports, record-level trip datasets, and consumer/driver surveys through commercial engagement. Gridwise does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its consumer, data-product, support, and policy surfaces.

companies.name: Miuros
companies.description: Miuros is a performance platform for customer service that provides AI-powered analytics, quality assurance (Review & Insights), and agent-assist automation (Assist) for international and scaling customer support teams. Founded as a standalone startup and backed by Techstars, Miuros was acquired by Dixa and is now offered as Miuros by Dixa. The Miuros product surface — Data sync, Review & Insights, Assist, and Miuros APIs — remains operational and is tracked on a dedicated Miuros status page, while platform developer documentation is served through the Dixa developer hub.

companies.name: Ooak Data
companies.description: Ooak Data is an applied AI research lab building the data infrastructure for frontier AI. It turns real company data into reinforcement-learning environments where AI agents learn to work in the real world — sourcing multimodal enterprise data, anonymizing it into digital twins of tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion and Jira, and generating expert-calibrated, multi-step, multi-tool workflow tasks calibrated on the latest frontier models. It serves frontier AI labs, enterprise AI teams, and AI startups that need real-world evaluation infrastructure rather than synthetic benchmarks. Backed by Y Combinator (Summer 2026) and based in Paris, France. Ooak Data publishes research essays and an AI-friendly content surface (llms.txt + Markdown content negotiation) but does not currently expose a public API or developer platform.

companies.name: Quago Technologies LTD
companies.description: Quago Technologies is a gaming analytics and fraud-detection company that uses machine learning and mobile device sensor data to protect and optimize mobile games. Its platform analyzes in-game behavioral and device-sensor patterns - without collecting personally identifiable information - to detect and manage cheating, identify user-acquisition (CPA) fraud, predict player churn, and optimize monetization and lifetime value. Quago is delivered to mobile game studios as an embedded SDK plus a backend analytics service rather than a public developer API; it was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: ResourceWise
companies.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

companies.name: Ripcord
companies.description: Ripcord is a document digitization and data-extraction company that uses proprietary robotics and AI to turn paper and digital records into structured, actionable business data. Its pipeline runs in three stages — robotic digitization (scanning paper to high-quality digital files), intelligence (AI classification, extraction, validation and enrichment), and action (accessing the resulting data through existing enterprise systems or Ripcord's Canopy cloud content-management platform). Ripcord serves manufacturing, financial services, insurance, real estate, energy, public sector, HR, food & beverage, and accounts-receivable management, with customers including Coca-Cola Bottlers, BP, UCLA, MUFG Bank, Agilent, and the IRS. Integration with enterprise systems (ERP, ECM, RPA, BI) is offered through direct engagement rather than a public developer API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of GV and Lux Capital.

companies.name: pandas
companies.description: pandas is a fast, powerful, flexible, and easy to use open source data analysis and manipulation tool, built on top of the Python programming language. It is a Python library that provides DataFrame and Series data structures and analysis tools; pandas itself does not expose an HTTP API, but is widely used to build data APIs alongside frameworks like FastAPI and Flask.

companies.name: Sensors Data
companies.description: Sensors Data (神策数据) is a customer data analytics and CDP (Customer Data Platform) company. Its platform unifies customer data across channels into real-time customer profiles and provides product analytics, user profiling, marketing and ad attribution, A/B testing, and smart-operations tooling. Sensors Data processes 250+ billion data points daily, ships 50+ data-collection SDKs across web, mobile, mini-program and server-side languages, and serves 2,000+ enterprise customers with both cloud and on-premise deployment. An OpenAPI is exposed for ecosystem integration.

companies.name: Percolata
companies.description: Percolata is a Palo Alto, California predictive-analytics company that applies machine learning to help retailers optimize labor scheduling and marketing spend. Its platform forecasts hourly sales, in-store traffic, and takeout demand to drive staffing optimization and marketing budget allocation, with published claims of 4x higher forecast accuracy, 10-20% same-store sales lift, and a forecast-accuracy guarantee. Named customers include 7-Eleven, Uniqlo, and Telefonica. The company is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Google Ventures (GV). Percolata does not publish a public developer portal or REST API reference; its retail platform is delivered as a managed product with custom application integration. The percolata.com marketing site is now served by Wix, which provisions a live, first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint and an llms.txt for agentic access to public site content.

companies.name: Divebell
companies.description: Divebell is a cloud-native data privacy and security compliance platform that helps organizations discover, classify, and protect sensitive data and personally identifiable information (PII) across their data sources. The platform pairs continuous, intelligent data scanning with "Deep Automation" to deliver four capability areas: Data Discovery (data classification, data mapping, and access management), Compliance Automation (risk assessment, data retention, and regulatory compliance), DSR Fulfillment (data subject request workflows, subject mapping, and automated retrieval), and Risk Protection (a policy engine, "Risk Sonar," and remediation actions). Delivered as a lightweight modern SaaS with private data processing, Divebell protects customer data across sources such as Snowflake and AWS. Divebell was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and is now part of the Exterro family, operating as Exterro Data Discovery.

companies.name: EcoPlant
companies.description: EcoPlant provides an intelligent air compressor control and monitoring platform for industrial facilities. The Ecoplant 360 solution uses IoT sensors, AI-powered dynamic controls, and predictive analytics to optimize compressed-air systems in real time, preventing downtime, improving reliability, and reducing compressed-air energy costs by up to 50 percent. It installs in under a week with no installation fees and is compatible with most compressor brands and existing plant technology.

companies.name: Handl Health
companies.description: Handl Health is a healthcare price-transparency AI platform that turns the negotiated rates, gross charges, and cash prices unlocked by the Hospital Price Transparency and Transparency in Coverage rules into clean, usable pricing intelligence. Using proprietary AI models, Handl cleans and organizes publicly available machine-readable pricing files at scale and supplements them with claims, Medicare rates, and provider-directory data to build a holistic, validated dataset. Its products — Iris, AI-driven network analytics for benefits consultants to evaluate and compare carrier networks, and Arke, real-time cost tools that help plan members find high-value care — serve benefits consultants, carriers, third-party administrators, and employers designing alternative health plans. Handl is a Techstars- and StartUp Health-backed company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API or portal was found at the time of enrichment.

companies.name: Ireland Open Data Catalogue

companies.name: Kaavio
companies.description: Kaavio is an AI-powered product content platform for B2B distributors and manufacturers. It sources product data from supplier submissions, PDFs, spec sheets, internal systems (PIM, DAM, ERP) and the web, validates it with conflict detection and confidence scoring, generates market-ready content (structured attributes, SEO descriptions, FAQs, comparisons, substitutes), and deploys it to destination systems such as PIMs, e-commerce platforms, and channels. The platform handles catalogs ranging from 20,000 to more than a million SKUs and claims a 90% reduction in the time and effort to get market-ready SKU content online. Founded by Derek Gregg and Sam Bobb, based in San Francisco, and backed by Baukunst, Techstars, and Looking Glass Capital ($2.9M pre-seed).

companies.name: Numetric
companies.description: Numetric operates a cloud data-analytics platform exposed through the Numetric REST API (api.numetric.com) alongside a developer portal and an Intercom-hosted help center for support. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public API surface. The public API is authentication-gated and the marketing site is bot-protected, so this profile captures the verified developer, API, and support surfaces discovered by live probes.

companies.name: Randolph-Brooks FCU
companies.description: Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union (RBFCU) is a member-owned, not-for-profit federal credit union headquartered in Live Oak, Texas, federally insured by the NCUA and serving more than one million members across Texas and beyond. Chartered as a federal credit union rather than a state or national bank, RBFCU is one of the largest credit unions in the United States by membership and assets, offering retail banking, mortgages, auto loans, credit cards, and deposit products through branches and digital channels. As a member-focused retail institution, RBFCU publishes no first-party public developer program, API documentation, or downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger specifications; consumer-permissioned account data is reached through third-party aggregators (such as Plaid, MX, Finicity, or Akoya) rather than a directly documented open-finance API, and it publishes no stated CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture or documented FDX participation.

companies.name: Umbria Region Open Data
companies.description: Umbria Region Open Data is a regional government open-data portal for Italy running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 457 datasets.

companies.name: Customer Analytics
companies.description: Customer Analytics (CA) is a data, analytics and AI consultancy headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin with a delivery centre in Guindy, Chennai, India. The firm delivers AI/ML and data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence and reporting, business solutions design and software development, platform implementation and software management (Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Fabric, Salesforce), and quality assurance. Alongside these services it packages six productised offerings — DataWorks 360, BI Xpert 360, AI Assist 360, Retail AI Insights 360, PBILens 360 and Smart IoT Data Track 360 — and publishes case studies across healthcare, manufacturing, retail/B2B, education, agriculture, clinical research, warehouse operations, the art industry and government. Customer Analytics is a professional services company: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API specifications.

companies.name: Human Archive
companies.description: Human Archive is a Stanford- and Berkeley-founded, Y Combinator-funded data lab building foundational multimodal datasets for training AI and robotics systems to understand human movement and interaction. It collects and labels first-person video, RGB-D, audio, tactile, and motion-capture data from a network of 100,000+ contributors and 500+ industry partners, and provides dataset access to researchers and enterprise partners through a customer dashboard on request. The company is a B2B data infrastructure provider rather than a self-serve platform, and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation at this time.

companies.name: Media Chain
companies.description: Mediachain (Mediachain Labs) was a decentralized universal media library and attribution protocol built on IPFS and blockchain technology, designed to let creators and applications collaborate on open metadata about creative works and track the provenance and ownership of online images and other media. Founded in 2016 with seed funding from Andreessen Horowitz and Union Square Ventures, the company was acqui-hired by Spotify in April 2017 to help build fair, blockchain-based royalty attribution for rightsholders. The company is now defunct and its primary domain (mediachain.io) is a parked page, but its open-source protocol, design documentation, Protocol Buffer definitions, and first-party client libraries (the `aleph`/`mcclient` JavaScript client on npm and the `mediachain-client` Python reader on PyPI) remain public under the github.com/mediachain organization. This profile was surfaced as an a16z portfolio company and enriched from its surviving open-source surface.

companies.name: Theretailequation
companies.description: The Retail Equation (TRE) is an Irvine, California software and analytics company that helps retailers detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and reduce return/exchange policy abuse. Its core Transaction Authorization service analyzes a shopper's linked purchase, return, and exchange history in real time and returns an approve, warn, or deny recommendation at the point of return — scoring transaction frequency, value, and receipt status while explicitly excluding demographic factors. TRE is part of Appriss Retail. The public web presence is a marketing and consumer-inquiry site plus an authenticated retailer Return Activity Report (RAR) portal; no public developer program, API documentation, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface is published.

companies.name: Upsight
companies.description: Upsight was a mobile analytics and marketing platform for apps and games — positioning itself as a "user lifecycle management platform" combining omnichannel analytics, integrated web and mobile marketing, ad optimization, and a DataMine SQL analytics product behind a single SDK for iOS, Android, tvOS, Unity, and Web. A Battery Ventures portfolio company, the platform is now defunct - upsight.com no longer resolves, the help.upsight.com developer docs survive only in the Internet Archive, and the GitHub org has been dormant since 2020, though the UpsightKit CocoaPods SDK and the doctor PyPI package remain published.

companies.name: Acerta
companies.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is a Canadian industrial-AI company whose LinePulse platform delivers AI-driven manufacturing quality analytics for discrete manufacturing. Founded in 2017 in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario, Acerta helps Tier-1 automotive and powertrain manufacturers detect defects early, reduce scrap and rework, and root-cause complex production issues in real time. LinePulse replaces statistical process control software, spreadsheets, and custom querying tools with real-time SPC, predictive monitoring, and machine-learning root-cause analysis, and ingests production data through a proprietary secure ingestion API. The platform is built on Microsoft Azure, is SOC 2 Type 1 certified, and is proven across 300+ production lines in 12 countries with customers including BorgWarner, Dana, Linamar, Ford, ZF, Ballard, and BMW. Acerta is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. Acerta exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, self-serve sign-up, or SDKs; integration is delivered through enterprise deployment with the LinePulse ingestion API.

companies.name: AdStage.io
companies.description: AdStage was a cross-network advertising management, reporting, and automation platform (a 500 Startups / 500 Global portfolio company, founded 2013) that let marketers pull normalized advertising data from Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest, Amazon, Google Analytics and more through a single unified interface. Its AdStage Data API (v1 and v2, HAL+JSON over HTTP with bearer-token / OAuth 2 auth) exposed user, organization, and advertising-entity data plus customizable cross-network reports. AdStage was acquired by TapClicks in April 2020 and folded into TapClicks' Marketing Intelligence platform; the standalone AdStage Data API (platform.adstage.io) is now defunct, though the AdStage GitHub organization and its API Blueprint documentation remain public. The adstage.io domain now serves unrelated PPC/advertising content under new ownership.

companies.name: Illuminate Education
companies.description: Illuminate Education is a K-12 education technology company providing assessment, data analytics, and Multi-Tiered System of Supports (MTSS) tools to schools and districts. Its platform serves roughly 17 million students across 5,200 schools and districts in all 50 states, taking a "whole child" approach that combines academic and social-emotional-behavioral data. Marquee products are FastBridge (universal screening and progress monitoring), DnA (standards-based assessment creation and scoring), and eduCLIMBER (MTSS collaboration and district data management). Illuminate does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI; data exchange runs through education-interoperability standards (LTI 1.0/1.1 Certified, OneRoster, Ed-Fi 2.5+, QTI) and partner/SIS/LMS integrations. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners, headquartered in Irvine, California.

companies.name: Newton Research
companies.description: Newton Research builds a team of specially trained AI agents for marketing analytics. Pre-built or custom agents connect to a customer's existing data infrastructure, write and execute code, and automate analytics workflows — data exploration and preparation, audience management, Customer 360, planning and activation, cross-channel measurement and attribution, anomaly detection, yield management, and automated reporting — with data remaining on the customer's own instance. Founded by John Hoctor, Matthew Emans, and Steven Bennett, the company is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program. Newton states SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA compliance. No public developer API surface is published as of this profile.

companies.name: TimeTrace Labs
companies.description: TimeTrace Labs is a London-based mathematics and artificial intelligence company building the measurement layer for healthcare, spun out of a decade of research at the University of Oxford and backed by Seedcamp and Fly Ventures. Its quantitative measurement platform separates signal from noise in multimodal physiological time-series (kinematics, EEG, ECG, actigraphy, glucose, voice), powering analytics for drug development, clinical trials, and public health that the company delivers to partners through secure APIs and a compliant analytics dashboard — though it publishes no public developer portal or API documentation yet.

companies.name: Whip Media Group
companies.description: Whip Media is a SaaS company powering the global media and entertainment industry through its AI-native Helix platform, which connects content licensors and licensees across the rights-to-royalties value chain. Helix spans supply-chain modules for licensees (avails management, contract management, royalties processing) and distribution modules for licensors (asset order management, performance tracking, revenue recognition), plus AI-powered Title Management for metadata enrichment and standardization. Customers include NBCU, Warner Bros. Discovery, Paramount, Sony, and Lionsgate. The company publishes an SEO llms.txt and reports SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II audits for a sixth consecutive year, but does not expose a public developer portal or documented API. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of IVP.

companies.name: Eyva
companies.description: Eyva (operated by datazeit GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is an AI-powered portfolio-intelligence platform for the beauty and personal-care industry. It unifies consumer, market, and product data so product, marketing, and R&D teams can detect emerging consumer trends across Google search, TikTok, Instagram, and product reviews, benchmark their portfolio, run gap and competitive analysis, track ingredients and claims, and develop AI-assisted product concepts. The platform bundles an AI research assistant, automated AI reporting, and data-backed product recommendations, and is used by 700+ teams at brands including Beiersdorf, Nivea, dm, BASF, Babor, and Lavera. Eyva is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. It is a B2B SaaS delivered through a demo-led sales motion and an authenticated web application; no public developer API surface is currently published.

companies.name: Kayum
companies.description: Kayum (KAYUM, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) is a Mexico City-based insurance data-analytics and software company serving the Mexican insurance market. It gives insurers exclusive, continuously updated market intelligence and actionable analysis: monthly price panels for GMM (major-medical), Life, and Auto lines backed by data from more than ten leading insurers, competitive pricing models, a quotation-processing tool (Claveteador) that compresses quote data preparation from days to minutes, customer-facing quoting platforms (Cotizadores) processing over 100,000 auto quotes a month, and compliance/document verification tooling (Suite 492 / ID Documental). Backed by 500 Global. The company publishes a marketing website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

companies.name: Pinnacle Financial
companies.description: Pinnacle Financial Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ: PNFP) is a Nashville, Tennessee based regional bank holding company whose principal subsidiary, Pinnacle Bank, is a Tennessee state-chartered, FDIC-insured commercial bank (FDIC Cert #35583) originally founded in 2000 as Pinnacle National Bank and renamed in 2012. Pinnacle operates across the Southeast — Tennessee, the Carolinas, Virginia, Georgia and Alabama — serving consumer, small-business, commercial and wealth clients. On the open-finance side Pinnacle runs NO public first-party developer API portal; its consumer digital and mobile banking is delivered on a third-party core/digital platform (Apiture), and consumer-permissioned account and transaction data is made available to fintechs only through data aggregators (Plaid and Finicity/Mastercard) rather than through a documented bank-operated API. No direct Financial Data Exchange (FDX) membership or published CFPB Section 1033 data-access posture was found; open-finance participation is aggregator-mediated.

companies.name: Prospera Credit Union
companies.description: Prospera Credit Union is a member-owned cooperative financial institution headquartered in British Columbia, Canada, formed on January 1, 2020 through the merger of the original Prospera Credit Union and Westminster Savings Credit Union — the largest credit-union merger in Canadian history. With roughly CA$9 billion in assets under management, about 120,000 members, and some 900 employees across branches in Metro Vancouver, the Fraser Valley, and the Okanagan, it is the third largest credit union in British Columbia and among the six largest in Canada. As a provincially regulated cooperative (credit unions in BC are overseen by BC Financial Services Authority and deposits are protected by the Credit Union Deposit Insurance Corporation of BC), Prospera serves personal and business members with chequing and savings accounts, credit cards, mortgages, loans, and Interac e-Transfer. On the open-finance side, Prospera runs NO public first-party developer portal or documented API — none of developer/api/developers.prospera.ca resolve — and Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open-banking) framework, legislated in Budget 2024 and overseen by the FCAC, is not yet operational. Like most Canadian credit unions, Prospera reaches national payment rails and consumer data-sharing through shared credit-union-system infrastructure rather than a proprietary API, and third-party data access today is aggregator/screen-scraping based (e.g. Flinks, Plaid). This is an honest identity-only profile with no public API surface to catalog.

companies.name: pulseData
companies.description: PulseData, Inc. is a healthcare artificial-intelligence company that applies machine learning and predictive analytics to chronic disease management, with a focus on chronic kidney disease. Its platform helps payers, providers, ACOs, and value-based care organizations identify at-risk patient populations, predict disease progression, and act by directing patients to targeted interventions and care programs. Named customers include Quest Diagnostics, US Renal Care, Vytalize, and HealthEdge. The company is SOC 2 Type II certified and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta. No public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable documentation were found during enrichment.
