companies.name: Celebal Technologies
companies.description: Celebal Technologies is an enterprise data and AI consulting and engineering firm founded in 2016 and headquartered in Jaipur, India, with delivery across 13 countries and more than 3,000 certified professionals. It partners with organizations on digital transformation across Data Engineering, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, cloud and database migration, SAP Extend & Innovate, app modernization, and enterprise cloud integration, building on Microsoft Azure, Databricks, AWS, and SAP. Proprietary products include Konverto AI, CT VMS, CT Passport, CT Vision, Eagle Eye IQ, PuFF, and Chronify, serving manufacturing, retail & CPG, oil & gas, energy, BFSI, healthcare, media & entertainment, public sector, ITES, and education. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners; no public API or developer surface was found.

companies.name: Convergys
companies.description: Convergys was a global leader in customer management services, providing customer care, technology services, and analytics across industries before being acquired by Concentrix in October 2018. The legacy convergys.com domain now redirects to Concentrix, and Convergys offerings such as contact center outsourcing, workforce management, analytics, and digital customer experience platforms have been folded into the Concentrix portfolio. Concentrix itself does not publish public REST APIs or developer programs in the way SaaS vendors do. Most platform integrations are delivered through enterprise contracts and private APIs.

companies.name: Datasembly
companies.description: Datasembly is a real-time retail intelligence platform that collects hyperlocal pricing, promotion, and assortment data from physical and online retail locations. The company reports gathering 12+ billion weekly prices across 150K+ stores from 230+ retailers, building a dataset of more than 2 trillion observations that consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands and retailers use to optimize pricing strategy, measure trade-spend effectiveness, monitor competitors, evaluate key value items, and plan seasonal launches. Datasembly delivers this competitive intelligence as fully shareable data and analytics rather than a public developer API. The company was acquired by SPINS. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API, developer portal, or API documentation was found on the provider's surface at the time of enrichment.

companies.name: Enigmalabs
companies.description: Enigma Labs operates a crowdsourced platform for reporting, tracking, and analyzing unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP) and UFO sightings, positioning itself as a destination for UFO sighting alerts and aerial intelligence. Through a mobile app (iOS and Google Play) and a web platform with a map interface and sighting-submission flow, a global community of sky watchers contributes reports that the company enriches with data science, machine-learning analysis, real-time alerts, and historical context. Enigma Labs reports over 57,000 sightings, more than 570,000 sky watchers, and around 2,000 high-signal UAP events, and has been featured by NBC News, PBS Nova, Scientific American, The Guardian, and The New Yorker. It is a portfolio company of Kindred Ventures. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public web presence as a consumer-facing product rather than an API provider.

companies.name: InfoScout (acquired by Numerator in 2017)
companies.description: InfoScout (acquired by Numerator in 2017) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: commerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

companies.name: nPlan
companies.description: nPlan applies machine learning to construction project schedules to forecast and de-risk large capital projects. Trained on a large corpus of historical project schedules, its products (nPlan Insights Pro and nPlan Portfolio) analyze programme risk, benchmark schedules against similar projects, and surface the interventions most likely to keep delivery on time and on budget, with a Power BI integration for portfolio-level project controls. nPlan is a private enterprise SaaS company backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of this enrichment pass it exposes no public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI surface.

companies.name: Pvx Partners
companies.description: PvX Partners (PvX Partners Pte Ltd) is a Singapore-based fintech platform that provides non-dilutive, performance-based user-acquisition (UA) financing for mobile gaming and consumer app studios. Its PvX Capital product offers a flexible credit line covering up to 80% of monthly marketing spend with no equity dilution, term sheets within 24 hours, and funds within 30 days, secured by and repaid from funded user cohorts. PvX Lambda is a cohort intelligence engine offering cohort-based ROAS projections, benchmarking, and funding-eligibility analysis across 650+ apps and 14,500+ cohorts, and PvX Delta rounds out the analytics suite. The firm reports $1B+ in capital committed across 100+ client companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of General Catalyst and profiled in the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer API at this time.

companies.name: Resultid
companies.description: Resultid is an enterprise Operational Intelligence platform that connects what customers say, what teams do, and what operational data shows across every product, location, and service to surface hidden revenue opportunities. It ingests data from hundreds of sources - surveys, calls, CRM systems, reviews, and service records - and applies AI to identify the behavioral patterns that separate high-performing locations from underperformers, bridging the gap between well-measured technical operations and largely invisible human operations. The platform serves automotive, airlines, hospitality, financial services, and retail enterprises. Resultid is a Techstars-backed company; this API Evangelist profile was enriched from its public web presence, which today exposes no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs - the product is delivered through an authenticated application.

companies.name: Second Measure
companies.description: Bloomberg Second Measure provides alternative data analytics for investors, turning billions of anonymized U.S. consumer card-transaction purchases into daily insights on the performance of thousands of public and private companies and brands. It is a Bloomberg product delivered primarily through the Bloomberg Terminal (ALTD and ECAN commands) and via aggregated and transaction-level data feeds, with 2-, 3-, and 7-day delivery lags that support intra-quarter earnings forecasting and investment monitoring. Second Measure was founded as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company and acquired by Bloomberg in 2020. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; access is gated through Bloomberg data products rather than a self-serve web API.

companies.name: Secondmeasure
companies.description: Bloomberg Second Measure is an alternative-data analytics provider that turns billions of anonymized U.S. consumer transaction records into daily company- and sector-level performance signals for investors and corporate strategy teams. It tracks thousands of public and private companies with 8+ years of transaction history, offering configurable lag options (2-day, 3-day, 7-day) from card swipe. Following its acquisition by Bloomberg, its analytics and transaction-level data feeds are delivered primarily through the Bloomberg Terminal (ALTD <GO> and ECAN <GO>) and enterprise data feeds rather than a public self-serve developer API. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API surface was found on the provider's site as of this pass.

companies.name: StreetMetrics
companies.description: StreetMetrics is an out-of-home (OOH) advertising measurement, planning, and attribution platform that gives operators, agencies, and brands data-driven tools to plan campaigns, track delivery in near real-time across 1.6M+ OOH units, and measure business outcomes from outdoor advertising. Its SmartSearch planning intelligence surfaces unit-level performance and audience insights, daily-refreshed impression measurement tracks delivery, and attribution connects OOH exposure to website visits, app opens, and in-store lift. No public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation are published; access is delivered through the product platform (Intelligence, Measurement, Attribution, StreetCity) and verified partner operators.

companies.name: data.gov.hr
companies.description: data.gov.hr (Portal otvorenih podataka) is the national government open-data portal for Croatia, operated by the Ministry of Justice and Public Administration. It runs CKAN 2.9.9 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 3,858 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access, plus DCAT-AP RDF/XML catalog feeds for EU harvesting. Note that the CKAN API is mounted under a non-default /ckan/ path prefix; root-level CKAN URLs return the Vue single-page-app HTML rather than JSON.

companies.name: data.gov.rs
companies.description: data.gov.rs is the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Serbia, operated by the Office for IT and eGovernment. It runs the uData platform and exposes the uData REST API over approximately 3,452 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, organization listings, and resource access. The API provides a consistent JSON-over-HTTP interface and is harvested into the EU data portal.

companies.name: dataset.gov.md (Portalul Datelor Deschise)
companies.description: dataset.gov.md is the national government open-data catalog for the Republic of Moldova (Portalul Datelor Deschise). The landing portal at date.gov.md links out to this catalog, which runs CKAN 2.10.4 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 1,275 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. No API key is required for read endpoints.

companies.name: Skience (The Athene Group)
companies.description: Skience, a product of The Athene Group, is a wealth management technology company that delivers a Salesforce-based platform for firms undergoing digital transformation. Its platform serves broker-dealers, registered investment advisors (RIAs), and enterprise wealth management organizations with digital client and advisor onboarding, automated account opening, data management and aggregation, and advisor productivity tooling built natively on the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud ecosystem. Skience is backed by Insight Partners and operates as a private SaaS provider; it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal, but it does maintain a SafeBase-hosted trust center documenting SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 2 + HITRUST attestations and a responsible disclosure program.

companies.name: TD Bank Group
companies.description: TD Bank Group (The Toronto-Dominion Bank) is one of Canada's Big Six chartered banks — a federally regulated Schedule I bank headquartered in Toronto and listed on the TSX and NYSE under the ticker TD. It is among North America's largest banks by assets, serving roughly 27 million customers worldwide across Canadian Personal & Commercial Banking (TD Canada Trust), U.S. Retail (TD Bank, N.A. — America's Most Convenient Bank, a separately profiled entity), and Wholesale Banking (TD Securities). Like the rest of Canada's banking sector, TD's open-finance posture is voluntary: Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking framework was legislated in 2024 (Consumer-Driven Banking Act) but is not yet operational, so the Canadian parent exposes no first-party public developer API. Consumer financial-data access today is aggregator-based — TD signed a North American data-access agreement with Plaid in December 2023 — while payments run over the shared Canadian rails (Interac e-Transfer and Payments Canada's Real-Time Rail, with Interac as the RTR exchange solution provider). The FDX-aligned, Akoya-based open-banking API suite published at developer.td.com belongs to the U.S. subsidiary TD Bank, N.A., not this Canadian entity.

companies.name: OSIsoft
companies.description: OSIsoft was the enterprise software company behind the PI System, the operational data infrastructure used across manufacturing, energy, utilities, oil and gas, and other industrial sectors to collect, historize, contextualize, and visualize high-volume real-time sensor and control-system time-series data. Its developer surface centered on the PI Web API (a RESTful interface to the PI Data Archive and Asset Framework), AF SDK, and the PI Square developer community. OSIsoft was acquired by AVEVA in 2021; all osisoft.com and docs.osisoft.com properties now redirect to AVEVA, where the product ships as the AVEVA PI System. This profile is maintained as a historical/acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network, with developer resources pointing at the live AVEVA successor pages.

companies.name: Skycatch
companies.description: Skycatch built spatial data capture, processing, and analytics for mining and construction sites, turning drone and aerial imagery into high-precision 3D data, volumetrics, and AI-driven site insights. Its products included Spatial Sight, Spatial DataHub (datahub.skycatch.com), and EdgeServer for on-site edge processing. Skycatch was acquired by Caterpillar Inc. on July 7, 2026 (following Caterpillar's RPMGlobal acquisition) to expand its mining technology capabilities. A developer platform exists at docs.skycatch.com but is password-gated, and no public API specification is available. Originally surfaced as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company.

companies.name: Everstring
companies.description: EverString was a B2B predictive marketing and sales intelligence platform that used data science, machine learning, and a proprietary business data cloud to help go-to-market teams identify their best-fit accounts. Its capabilities included predictive lead and account scoring, account-based marketing segmentation, firmographic enrichment, similar-company discovery, ML-generated keywords, and industry classification, exposed to developers through an Enrichment API on developer.everstring.com secured with access-token authentication. Founded in 2012 and backed by investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, EverString was acquired by ZoomInfo in November 2019 and its data and predictive capabilities were folded into the ZoomInfo platform; the everstring.com website now redirects to ZoomInfo Operations and the standalone developer portal has been largely decommissioned. This profile documents the historical API surface and current public footprint.

companies.name: Plan0 Ai
companies.description: Plan0 AI is a real estate construction technology company that applies AI to preconstruction cost estimation and design analysis. Its platform turns architectural drawings into detailed cost estimates and 3D models in roughly 30 minutes rather than the traditional two-week cycle, and adds automated takeoff and pricing, value-engineering scenario simulation, and predictive analytics. Plan0 AI serves real estate developers underwriting and making preconstruction design decisions, general contractors producing business- development estimates and cost forecasts, and investors validating pro-formas and benchmarking. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing and demo-booking website only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

companies.name: Rainmarket
companies.description: Rainmarket is the flagship intelligence platform of Digital Media Nusantara (DMN), built to map and illuminate cross-border trade flows between ASEAN and Hong Kong's Greater Bay Area. It combines three integrated engines — Supply Chain Intelligence, a Tariff Tracker, and a Trade Flows Mapping engine — to turn roughly USD100 billion in previously unmapped or mispriced regional trade activity into investible, financeable, and transparently governed flows. The platform is architected for sovereign-grade deployment, targeting the security, compliance, and resiliency thresholds required by central banks, financial regulators, and national-level intelligence environments, and serves institutional investors, financial institutions, market regulators, and enterprise treasury and supply-chain teams. Rainmarket was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable service surface.

companies.name: TigerEye
companies.description: TigerEye is an AI company for the construction industry, helping builders get answers faster and spend less time searching for information across construction, business intelligence, and home planning and delivery workflows. Founded as an Initialized Capital-backed startup and acquired by homebuilder Lennar to scale its capabilities nationally, TigerEye operates a public marketing site with an About page, Terms of Use, and Privacy Policy. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, documentation, or well-known discovery surface, and its former Secureframe-hosted trust center now redirects to a 404.

companies.name: TNL Mediagene
companies.description: TNL Mediagene is a next-generation digital and technology media group serving millennial and Gen Z audiences across Asia. Formed from the 2023 merger of Taiwan's The News Lens and Japan's Mediagene, the group operates more than twenty media brands spanning news, business, technology, lifestyle, and sports — including The News Lens, INSIDE, Cool3c, Gizmodo Japan, Business Insider Japan, Lifehacker Japan, Roomie, and licensed titles such as Digiday Japan and Glossy Japan. Beyond publishing, the company runs advertising and marketing technology (the Ad2iction DSP), an AI-driven customer data and audience analytics platform, e-commerce properties, and market-research services. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer or API surface is published at this time.

companies.name: Trace
companies.description: Trace (tracehq.com) is a workforce planning, headcount management, and procurement platform where companies plan and manage headcount as their most important investment, offering instant workforce analytics and headcount planning. Trace was backed by 500 Global and Uncork Capital, was acquired by Paylocity (now branded "TraceHQ, A Paylocity Company"), and the standalone Trace app is being sunset in early 2026 as the product folds into Paylocity for Finance headcount planning. Trace publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: EverestLabs
companies.description: EverestLabs builds AI, computer vision, and robotics for the recycling industry. Its RecycleOS platform identifies, tracks, and sorts recoverable materials on the conveyor lines of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), giving recyclers, reclaimers, and packaging manufacturers analytics, bale tracing, plant optimization, and compliance reporting to increase recovery rates, cut labor costs, and verify recycled content. Headquartered in Fremont, California and backed by Sierra Ventures. EverestLabs does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, GitHub, and discovery surface.

companies.name: Lifemote
companies.description: Lifemote Networks is an Istanbul-based provider of AI-driven home Wi-Fi analytics and experience management for broadband ISPs and network operators. A software agent running on the subscriber gateway or access point streams detailed in-home Wi-Fi performance telemetry to Lifemote's cloud, which scores quality of experience per household and per device and isolates root causes such as poor coverage, misplaced repeaters, congested or co-channel Wi-Fi, legacy client devices, and non-Wi-Fi interference. Operators consume the results through a web application for first-line support, proactive maintenance, churn detection and mesh/gateway upselling, plus quarterly expert-reviewed QoE reports. Lifemote markets a full-featured API for integrating this data with in-house OSS/BSS systems and support workflows, but that API is sold and provisioned through direct enterprise engagement — there is no public developer portal, documentation site, machine-readable specification, or self-service sign-up. Customers named publicly include A1, Community Fibre, Online.nl, and Tusass.

companies.name: Alluva
companies.description: Alluva operates a global analyst marketplace centered on cryptocurrency and digital-asset price predictions. Users forecast the future price of assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum across timeframes from 24 hours to six months, follow leading analysts, and earn redeemable rewards for accurate forecasts with no upfront investment. Asset pages surface detailed analysis and Buy/Hold/Sell recommendations. Alluva also packages its predictive market data for B2B customers - data providers, media houses, and financial institutions - with named clients including 500 Global, Refinitiv, Thomson Reuters, Economic Times, and Times of India. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is published at this time.

companies.name: Aon
companies.description: Aon plc is a London-headquartered global professional services firm delivering integrated risk and human capital advisory through two reporting pillars — Risk Capital (broking, reinsurance, risk analytics) and Human Capital (health, wealth, talent, rewards). The firm operates in over 120 countries, lists on the NYSE under the ticker AON, and grew its US middle-market footprint with the April 2024 acquisition of NFP for roughly $13B. Aon publishes named analytics platforms (Risk Analyzer suite, ReMetrica, CyQu, Spectrum, Impact Forecasting catastrophe models, Radford McLagan Compensation Database, SkillsGraph, Gauge, Revenue GPS) but those tools are delivered through gated client portals — no developer portal, OpenAPI catalog, SDK org, or public API reference is published on aon.com.

companies.name: Finres
companies.description: Finres (finres SAS) is a French climate-risk analytics company building a decision platform for agriculture. It translates climate hazards into economic consequences for farms, agricultural value chains and territories, combining agronomic, pedological, climate and market data with AI models that are peer-reviewed and validated against published research. Two productized offerings sit on top of the platform - a farm-level economic and climate viability diagnostic (DPEC, currently in beta, seeded from a grower's TelePAC parcel file and reference datasets such as Agreste, IPPAP and RICA) and bespoke territorial or sector studies. Finres was founded by Florent Baarsch, previously with the World Bank, the United Nations and climate research institutes, and its customers include the French government, the World Bank, the Green Climate Fund, IFAD and the FAO. The company markets high-resolution data delivery into customer decision systems, but as of this enrichment pass publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification or SDK - access is arranged through a sales demo.

companies.name: Market IQ
companies.description: Market IQ is a predictive analytics platform for financial institutions, serving retail banking, investment banking, and capital markets. It ingests both structured and unstructured data, applies natural language processing and AI to generate insights, and delivers bespoke dashboards such as its Social Net Promoter Score and incident-monitoring tools. The company operates from Toronto, New York, and London and reaches customers through login-gated applications rather than a public developer API. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Soria
companies.description: Soria is an AI-native financial terminal built for healthcare investors. The platform aggregates financial data from 125+ public and private sources into continuously updated financial models and delivers them through a terminal UI, an MCP server, an API, warehouse sync, and a research feed. Soria targets bulge-bracket banks, boutique research firms, and the largest hedge funds that specialize in the healthcare sector, turning fragmented healthcare and life sciences data into live, analyst-ready models. Backed by Y Combinator. Its public surface is a single-page marketing site; the API and MCP delivery channels are gated to customers and are not publicly documented.

companies.name: Striim
companies.description: Unified data integration and streaming platform offering change data capture (CDC), real-time streaming analytics, and data validation. Exposes a token-authenticated REST API (WActionStore queries, system health, Application Management) consumed against your own Striim instance or Striim Cloud service.

companies.name: Reporting Templates
companies.description: Pre-built document templates for generating standardized reports, dashboards, and data presentations with consistent formatting and structure. Organizations use reporting templates to track key metrics, identify trends, optimize business outcomes, and communicate data insights to stakeholders. This collection catalogs APIs and tools for working with report templates across business intelligence, analytics, document generation, and data visualization platforms.

companies.name: Yipitdata
companies.description: YipitData is a market-intelligence and alternative-data company that delivers daily insights on consumer behavior, market share, pricing, and company performance to the world's largest hedge funds, investors, brands, and retailers. Its Proprietary Data Network combines owned-and-operated B2C and B2B panels with 40+ always-on sources (consumer receipts, card transactions, B2B and cloud spend, web-scraped signals), analyzed on a Databricks/Delta Lake lakehouse and delivered through data-sharing, hosted apps, and its AI-powered Insight Agent rather than a public developer API.

companies.name: Acerta Analytics
companies.description: Acerta (Acerta Analytics Solutions Inc.) is an industrial AI company whose LinePulse platform applies machine learning to real-time discrete-manufacturing production data to detect and resolve quality defects early. It helps automotive and manufacturing teams reduce scrap, rework, and end-of-line testing while protecting throughput, ingesting data from MES, PLC, and QMS systems and deploying in under 30 days. Surfaced as an EQT Ventures portfolio company; no public developer API or documentation is exposed today (data connectivity is via a private ingestion API and prebuilt integrations such as ETQ and Microsoft).

companies.name: Aerodyne
companies.description: Aerodyne Group is a Malaysia-headquartered DT3 (drone technology, data technology, and digital transformation) enterprise solutions provider, founded in 2014. Through its Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) model and the AI-powered, cloud-based vertikaliti asset-management platform, Aerodyne turns aerial and sensor data into deep analytics and actionable insights for infrastructure, power line, wind turbine, solar, and agricultural (Agrimor) asset inspection and management. Operating across 45 countries with a global network of AeroRangers, it was ranked the world's number-one drone service provider by Drone Industry Insights in 2021 and 2022. Aerodyne is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer portal, API, or machine-readable specification has been identified at this time.

companies.name: B&L Information Systems
companies.description: B&L Information Systems, LLC is a metalcasting-focused enterprise resource planning (ERP) software company founded more than 50 years ago and headquartered in Bridgman, Michigan. Its flagship product, Odyssey ERP, is a cloud-based ERP purpose-built for foundries, die casters, and investment casters, spanning manufacturing, sales, inventory, quality, finance, and data analytics. B&L pairs the software with implementation, consulting, data-conversion, training, and support services tailored to the metalcasting industry. The company is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. As of this enrichment pass, B&L does not publish a public developer portal, REST API documentation, SDKs, or an OpenAPI definition, so this profile captures company identity and public web properties rather than an API surface.

companies.name: CommerceIQ
companies.description: CommerceIQ is an AI-powered ecommerce platform that helps consumer brands win in algorithmic retail across sales, digital shelf, retail media, and content execution. Its unified platform, Ally AI, packages four AI agents (Content, Shelf, Media, and Sales) that optimize product content and SEO, monitor digital-shelf availability and search rankings across 1,450+ retailers globally, manage and automate retail media bidding and spend, and forecast and execute sales strategy from Amazon and Walmart to Instacart and Criteo. Founded in 2019, CommerceIQ serves enterprise brands including PepsiCo, P&G, Coca-Cola, and Colgate-Palmolive, and is backed by Insight Partners, SoftBank Vision Fund, and Trinity Ventures. The company operates as a managed enterprise platform and does not publish a public self-service API or developer portal.

companies.name: Ematic Solutions
companies.description: Ematic Solutions is a digital marketing and marketing-technology consultancy headquartered in Singapore that helps B2C brands across Asia Pacific build integrated, high-ROI digital ecosystems. It combines strategy, implementation, and ongoing optimization across SEO, performance marketing, social media, CRM, conversion-rate optimization, analytics, and e-commerce (Shopify), and it implements and manages enterprise marketing clouds including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud, and Braze. The firm also runs social-CRM channels such as WhatsApp, LINE, and Zalo and partners with 100+ martech platforms (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Iterable, Segment, Mixpanel, and others). Backed by 500 Global, Ematic operates across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and beyond. It is a services and consulting company rather than an API producer, and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Graph Query Language (GQL)
companies.description: GQL is an international standard query language for property graph databases, developed by ISO/IEC JTC1 SC32 WG3 to provide a declarative way to query and manipulate graph data structures. Published as ISO/IEC 39075:2024 on April 17, 2024, the standard complements SQL for graph workloads and builds on prior art including openCypher, PGQL, GSQL, and G-CORE. Effective implementation supports data-driven strategies and helps maintain data integrity and portability across graph database systems.

companies.name: PitchMe
companies.description: PitchMe is a recruitment data intelligence platform that enriches, verifies, and deduplicates candidate records to turn an existing ATS or CRM database into an activated talent pool. It cleans and appends verified contact details, employment history, and skills data, then surfaces career-intelligence signals that power AI-driven sourcing and outreach. PitchMe connects to applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Salesforce, Lever, JobDiva, Vincere, Avionte, Jobvite, and Ashby via native and certified integrations, plus a custom API for connecting any ATS or recruitment platform. Backed by Techstars.

companies.name: PopCom
companies.description: PopCom is an AI-powered automated retail technology company founded by e-commerce entrepreneur Dawn Dickson. Its flagship product, the PopShop, is a robotic self-service kiosk that dispenses physical and digital products while capturing customer data through computer vision, facial recognition, and real-time analytics. The platform gives brands and entrepreneurs the kind of sales metrics, inventory monitoring, targeted advertising, and customer-sentiment insight that online retailers enjoy, but for physical, unattended retail. PopCom sells its hardware on an annual lease with a monthly software subscription. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass PopCom publishes no public developer platform, API, or specification.

companies.name: StoneEagle F&I
companies.description: StoneEagle F&I is an automotive Finance & Insurance (F&I) technology company that has spent more than 35 years building the software backbone of dealership F&I operations. Its product suite spans Variable Ops (StoneEagleMENU, an electronic F&I menu-selling and product-presentation system, and StoneEagleMETRICS, real-time DMS-sourced sales and F&I reporting), Fixed Ops (PENCILWRENCH and StoneEagleMETRICS SERVICE for the service drive), and industry benchmarking (StoneEagleDATA, transaction-level insight across more than half of U.S. franchised dealers). StoneEagle connects to dealerships through certified DMS integrations and partners such as Dealertrack and F&I Express, but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal — integration is delivered as private, certified dealer and partner connections. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures.

companies.name: Cork City Open Data
companies.description: Cork City Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 32 datasets.

companies.name: Dealogic
companies.description: Dealogic is a global provider of content and software for the capital markets, including deal-management, analytics, league-table, and compliance solutions used by investment banks, sales/trading desks, and investment managers. Dealogic delivers data and connectivity primarily through its Cortex platform, Dealogic Connect, and Analytics products rather than a self-service public developer API; integrations are contracted with customers and accessed under license rather than from a public developer portal.

companies.name: FTN Network
companies.description: FTN Network is a New York-based sports data, analytics, and content company founded in 2020 that helps fans, fantasy players, and sports bettors make smarter decisions. FTN operates the FTN Fantasy platform (ftnfantasy.com), publishing proprietary NFL charting data, projections, DFS ownership, and betting analytics through articles, livestreams, videos, and podcasts. FTN also sells a REST/JSON sports-data API covering NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, PGA, CFB, and CBB across CSV, mid-tier API, and enterprise white-label plans. The company went through the Techstars Sports Tech Accelerator (2022) and is backed by 11 Tribes Ventures.

companies.name: SmartDublin Open Data
companies.description: SmartDublin Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Ireland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 929 datasets.

companies.name: Compose
companies.description: Compose (Compose, Inc., compose.io) was a database-as-a-service (DBaaS) provider that offered production-ready, auto-scaling, hosted deployments of open-source databases — MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, RethinkDB, ScyllaDB, etcd, MySQL, and Disque — each provisioned with high availability, automated backups, and a REST API for programmatic management. Founded in 2010 as MongoHQ and rebranded to Compose in 2014, the company was backed by DCVC (Data Collective) and was acquired by IBM in 2015, after which the offering was folded into IBM Cloud as "IBM Compose" / IBM Cloud Databases. The standalone Compose service and its developer surface (compose.com, compose.io, apidocs.compose.com) have since been deprecated and taken offline. This profile documents the surviving, verifiable first-party artifacts — the archived GitHub organization at github.com/compose, the official Go SDK (gocomposeapi) wrapping the Compose REST API, and the official command-line tools (bach, cocli).

companies.name: Concord Systems
companies.description: Concord Systems was a Brooklyn, New York stream-processing company founded in December 2014 by Alexander Gallego and Emilio Del Tesoro, and backed by Bloomberg Beta. It built a high-performance distributed stream processing framework written in C++ on top of Apache Mesos, aimed at letting application developers and data scientists write real-time streaming computations ("operators") in the language of their choice — Python, Ruby, Go, Java/Scala, Node.js or Haskell — with Kafka and Amazon Kinesis connectors and a CLI for deploying topologies. Akamai Technologies acquired the company in an all-cash transaction in September 2016 and folded the technology into its IoT edge data platform for real-time messaging and log processing. The company is discontinued: concord.io is parked and the documentation site is gone. Its interface was a Thrift-based operator driver API rather than an HTTP/REST API, so there is no OpenAPI or event surface to catalog; the surviving first-party developer artifacts are the github.com/concord organization and the client libraries still published on PyPI, RubyGems and pkg.go.dev.

companies.name: Continual
companies.description: Continual was an operational-AI / MLOps platform for the modern data stack, founded by Tristan Zajonc (previously Sense, acquired by Cloudera) and Tyler Kohn (co-founder of RichRelevance). It let data and analytics teams declaratively build, deploy, and continuously maintain production predictive models directly inside cloud data warehouses — Snowflake, Databricks, and BigQuery — using SQL and dbt as the primary interface rather than bespoke ML pipelines. The company raised a seed round led by Amplify Partners and a $14.5M Series A in 2022. The product is now dormant: continual.ai is a parked single-page shell, the documentation host redirects to the homepage, and the last release of the first-party Python CLI + SDK on PyPI was in March 2023. This profile captures the verifiable public artifacts that remain — the PyPI package, the GitHub organization, and a live domain-security posture.

companies.name: Eos AI
companies.description: Eos AI is a San Francisco healthcare technology company building an autonomous operating system for healthcare that helps clinics and hospitals identify eligible patients and enable early care interventions. The platform connects to fragmented clinical systems (EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing), resolves patient identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history that can be searched and analyzed as one distributed database. Two harmonization products anchor the stack: VERA standardizes medical imaging across scanners, sites, and protocols to improve model performance and shorten deployment, and LUCIA structures EHR free text, ICD, SNOMED, and clinical signals into a unified representation for downstream analytics. On top of the harmonized data, Eos runs predictive models over full patient trajectories and drives automations into hospital workflows, reporting roughly 3x administrative productivity and 37% revenue recovery in early deployments. Founded in 2025 by Arya Khokhar and backed by Y Combinator (Winter 2026 batch). Its application is gated at my.helloeos.ai; no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal has been published to date, so this profile captures the company identity and the security posture of its public web surface.

companies.name: Truveris
companies.description: Truveris is an independent pharmacy benefits consulting and analytics firm, founded in 2009 and headquartered in New York, that helps employers, benefits consultants, and brokers optimize their pharmacy programs and reduce drug spend. The company turns complex pharmacy claims and contract data into clear, actionable insight through products including the Truveris Marketplace for PBM plan procurement, truGuard for ongoing contract and pricing oversight, pharmacy audits, and PBM contract analytics. Truveris serves hundreds of clients with data-driven cost containment strategies. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties. Backed by Canaan Partners.

companies.name: opendata.rks-gov.net (Kosovo Open Data) [offline]
companies.description: opendata.rks-gov.net (RKS Open Data) was the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Kosovo, historically running CKAN (~v2.7). As of mid-2025 the hostname no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN) and the portal is offline; the last Internet Archive snapshots are from June 2025. It is cataloged here as historical pending restoration. Sectoral government open-data services remain available (e.g. Kosovo Customs at dogana.rks-gov.net/OpenData and the national geoportal at geoportal.rks-gov.net).

companies.name: Pipelinedb
companies.description: PipelineDB was a high-performance PostgreSQL extension for continuous, incremental aggregation of time-series data using continuous SQL views, avoiding the need to store raw event data. It also offered Stride, a hosted streaming-analytics API with first-party Python, JavaScript, and Go client SDKs, plus extensions for Apache Kafka and Amazon Kinesis ingestion. The company joined Confluent in 2019; the open-source extension reached a final 1.0.0 release (Apache-2.0) and is now archived, while the pipelinedb.com website and the hosted Stride service have been retired. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of DCVC.

companies.name: PrimaryIO
companies.description: PrimaryIO is a Silicon Valley cloud workload management and data mobility company based in Los Altos, California, that helps enterprises safely leverage the public cloud. Its portfolio includes ProtectIO, a Disaster-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; RecoverIO, a Ransomware-Recovery-as-a-Service offering; ConvertIO, which migrates VMware VMs into cloud-native virtual server instances; and a tech-enabled Migration-as-a-Service. The platform uses changed-block replication to cloud object storage with data encryption in transit and at rest for non-disruptive migrations and on-demand VMware infrastructure. PrimaryIO is backed by Accel and Partech. It currently publishes no public developer API.

companies.name: Coded
companies.description: CODED is a Kuwait-based coding education and technology skills company offering hands-on bootcamps and programs for adults, youth, and kids. Its adult bootcamps cover Cybersecurity, Agentic AI, AI & Data Science, and AI App Development, while youth tracks (ages 14-24) and kids programs (ages 6-13) build foundational and career-oriented tech skills through projects, coaching, and real-world standards. CODED also delivers custom enterprise training for corporate teams. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; CODED is an education provider and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or specifications.

companies.name: Ergo
companies.description: Ergo (ergo Offers, Inc.) is a New York-based e-commerce pricing company that lets online shoppers name their own price. Its flagship product is a Shopify app that adds a "Make an Offer with ergo" button to product pages: a customer submits the price they are willing to pay and how long they are willing to wait, and the merchant accepts or rejects the offer from a backend dashboard. Beyond bartering, Ergo captures true willingness-to-pay data and turns it into pricing analytics and a price-discovery and optimization tool, helping retailers clear excess inventory and reduce blanket discounting. Founded and led by CEO Claire Stepanek (previously supply chain at Apple), Ergo raised a $1.5M pre-seed round in October 2023 led by Anthemis with Wischoff Ventures. Ergo does not currently publish a public developer API; this profile captures its company identity.

companies.name: PREDIK Data-Driven
companies.description: PREDIK Data-Driven is a big-data analytics and location-intelligence research firm (founded 2008, Coral Gables, Florida) that builds enriched geospatial datasets for site selection, demand forecasting, and web/reference intelligence. Its products cover Point-of-Interest (POI) data, aggregated foot-traffic and human mobility data derived from anonymized mobile devices, company and commercial-area intelligence, and socio-demographic enrichment - divided into geohash-7 (150x150m) cells with 100-200+ variables and coverage of up to 96 countries. PREDIK is a data-delivery / contact-sales provider - datasets are licensed and delivered as managed feeds via REST API, SOAP API, Feed API, or S3 bucket in JSON, CSV, and SQL formats. There is no public self-serve developer API portal or published API reference; access is arranged directly with PREDIK or through the Datarade marketplace. Endpoints are not publicly documented and are therefore not modeled here.

companies.name: Atrium
companies.description: Atrium is a sales-effectiveness and sales-performance business intelligence platform for revenue teams. It continuously monitors sales KPIs to surface anomalies in rep and team performance, detects which behaviors and activities are driving (or dragging) output, and delivers AI-powered coaching recommendations to managers and reps. The product connects directly to Salesforce, HubSpot, data warehouses, and communication tools rather than exposing a public developer API. Founded in San Francisco by Jason Heidema (CEO) and Peter Kazanjy and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Bullpen Capital, and Electric Capital, Atrium was acquired by Fullcast in 2025 and is now offered as Fullcast Performance; atriumhq.com redirects to fullcast.com and only the customer application login at app.atriumhq.com remains on the Atrium domain.

companies.name: Diamond
companies.description: Diamond (diamond.io) is an early-stage, managed serverless data backend for teams, positioned as "your project, but with AI." The product promises a world-class serverless database where teams bring their own data sources, AI-assisted setup so no schema configuration is required, team collaboration with role management, and single sign-on via Google, Microsoft, and LDAP. As of this profile the public surface is a pre-launch landing page with a "create your workspace" signup form and a sign-in page; no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, pricing, changelog, or status page are published yet. Diamond Inc. is a portfolio company of Partech. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead and enriched from the provider's public web surface.

companies.name: Foxintelligence
companies.description: Foxintelligence was a French e-commerce measurement and consumer-insights company that aggregated anonymized online purchase data from email receipts across millions of e-shoppers to give brands and retailers competitive intelligence on where, when, and how much consumers buy online. It was acquired by NielsenIQ and operates today as the "NIQ Digital Purchases" product; the original www.foxintelligence.io domain now 301-redirects to nielseniq.com. The surviving first-party surface is the customer web application at app.foxintelligence.io (login only). No public API, OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation is published; this profile is maintained as an acquired-company record in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Nazar
companies.description: Nazar (nazar.ai) is an AI-powered database performance and cost optimization platform that helps engineering and DBA teams monitor, analyze, and tune their databases. It supports Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, Amazon Aurora, Oracle, and SAP HANA across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Capabilities include SQL.AI, an LLM-based tuning assistant, offensive SQL monitoring for slow-query detection, real-time lock visibility, and anomaly detection. Founded in Recife, Brazil and backed by 500 Global, Nazar counts financial-services and travel companies among its customers.

companies.name: data.gov.mk
companies.description: data.gov.mk is the national government open-data portal for North Macedonia, operated by the Ministry of Digital Transformation. It runs CKAN and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over roughly 280+ datasets from 50+ public institutions, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access, plus DCAT exports (N3, TTL, XML, JSON-LD).

companies.name: RefineRE
companies.description: RefineRE is a commercial real estate (CRE) SaaS platform that unifies benchmarking, data analysis, and portfolio usage tools into a single product suite for corporate real estate teams. Its eight modules span data foundations, portfolio management, market analysis, ESG tracking, and workplace analytics, helping occupiers and CRE managers optimize their real estate portfolios. A Techstars-backed company, RefineRE is added to the API Evangelist network as a provider profile; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

companies.name: Arcion Labs
companies.description: Arcion Labs, Inc. built a distributed, in-memory change data capture (CDC) platform for real-time enterprise database replication. Its agentless, zero-code pipelines replicated data with low latency and high availability across 20+ enterprise databases and data warehouses (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks Delta Lake and more), driven by a YAML CLI, a workflow UI, and an API, with built-in schema conversion and evolution. Founded by CTO Rajkumar Sen and later led by CEO Gary Hagmueller, and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Databricks Ventures, Arcion was acquired by Databricks in November 2023 (deal valued at over $100M) and its technology now underpins Databricks Lakeflow Connect. This profile is retained for network history; the standalone product is no longer independently marketed.

companies.name: Zions Bancorporation
companies.description: Zions Bancorporation, National Association is a nationally chartered bank and bank holding company headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, with roughly $87 billion in total assets. It is a super-regional operating a single national bank charter across seven regional divisional brands - Zions Bank, Amegy Bank, California Bank & Trust, National Bank of Arizona, Nevada State Bank, Vectra Bank Colorado, and The Commerce Bank of Washington - serving consumers, small business, and commercial/treasury clients across the Western United States. On the open-finance front Zions runs NO public first-party developer API portal: developer.zionsbank.com and api.zionsbank.com do not resolve, and its business digital-banking surface (Treasury Internet Banking at treasurygateway.zionsbank.com) is credential-gated with no published API reference or downloadable OpenAPI. As a large depository institution it is subject to the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule, but Zions has not published a first-party data-access API or a documented FDX-conformant endpoint; consumer-permissioned data sharing in practice reaches Zions through third-party aggregators (Plaid/MX/Finicity/Akoya) rather than a first-party API surface.

companies.name: Horizon Media
companies.description: Horizon Media is the largest independent media agency in the United States, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg and headquartered at 75 Varick Street in New York with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto. The agency employs roughly 2,300+ people, is ranked the third largest US media agency by COMvergence, and manages an estimated $8.7 billion in billings. Horizon operates a portfolio of specialty units (Horizon Next for performance, Blue Hour Studios for social/creator, Night Market for retail media, Scout Sports for sponsorship via Horizon Sports & Experiences, and the WHY Group for cultural insights) and runs a proprietary data and AI stack anchored by the Blu platform. In 2025 Horizon formed Horizon Global, a 50/50 US joint venture with Havas positioned at roughly $20 billion in combined billings, merging Blu with Havas Converged into a shared platform branded BluConverged, and is also building Horizon OS (Open Sphere) as an orchestration layer over the programmatic ad-tech stack. Horizon Media does not publish any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, or external developer portals, and its GitHub organization is private. All platforms documented here are internal/client-facing proprietary systems rather than open developer APIs.

companies.name: Knotch
companies.description: Knotch is a New York-based content intelligence company founded by Anda Gansca and Aron Tzimas. Its Knotch One platform measures and optimizes owned-content performance for enterprise marketing teams, and its newer product, Ace, is positioned as AI experience infrastructure for the conversational web: it ingests a brand's existing web properties, content hubs, video and feeds, atomizes them into modular content units tagged by topic, audience, funnel stage and intent, then composes adaptive page experiences for human visitors while emitting structured, citable content for AI agents and answer engines. Named enterprise customers include Google, Deloitte, Ally, Zillow, Cox Automotive, GEICO, Synchrony, Square, Dropbox, FOX and Chime. As of July 2026 Knotch publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, SDK or package registry presence; access is sales-led.

companies.name: Mecka AI
companies.description: Mecka AI is the data and deployment layer for physical AI — it captures, structures, and evaluates real-world human and robot activity into datasets that robotics and embodied-AI teams can train on. Rather than building robots, Mecka positions itself as the integrator of the robotics ecosystem, plugging into hardware makers, frontier model labs, and commercial partners and owning the last-mile data, annotation, QA, and evaluation layer between them. Its Egoverse dataset captures large-scale first-person (egocentric) human activity across tasks and environments, and a companion iOS app lets teams collect task-specific data at scale. Mecka is backed by Forerunner Ventures and raised a $60M Series A in 2026. As of this pass Mecka publishes a marketing site, an iOS data-collection app, and the Egoverse data platform, but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Spatialedge
companies.description: Spatialedge is an enterprise AI and data solutions firm headquartered in Stellenbosch, South Africa, with offices in London and Austin. The company builds and operationalizes analytical tooling that turns data into data-driven business decisions, spanning consulting and AI maturity assessments, custom solution development (data pipelines, optimization and forecasting models, AI-powered applications), integration and deployment into existing business systems, and ongoing MLOps and model maintenance. Products include Workforce Planner, Price Planner, Demand Forecaster, and DataLlume, applied across retail pricing, telecom infrastructure, and mining predictive maintenance. Spatialedge does not publish a public API, SDK, or developer portal; it is a services and solutions provider surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Specific Labs
companies.description: Specific Labs is a Y Combinator-backed (Fall 2025) applied AI research lab based in San Francisco and operated by Bear AI Inc. The company builds datasets and benchmarks derived from real enterprise workflows, capturing authentic business decision-making patterns and audio and enterprise data that are otherwise hard to access, and turns them into training data and evaluation benchmarks for building reliable, domain-grounded AI agents. It works with frontier AI labs seeking datasets from real enterprises and with enterprises building dependable agents. Founded by Janak Sunil (CEO, formerly Coinbase) and Siddhant Paliwal (CTO). As of this profile Specific Labs publishes a marketing site with a benchmarks page and company information, and does not yet expose a public API, SDKs, or developer portal.

companies.name: Relatable.io
companies.description: Relatable is a Product Relationship Management (PRM) platform for the medical technology and medical device industry, based in Nashville, Tennessee and backed by Techstars. Its Product Data Catalog centralizes competitive product intelligence, its Guided Purchase Solution turns that data into commercial insight, and 3rd-party data integrations sync external sources such as pricing intelligence. The platform serves contracting (RFP responses), sales (business reviews), marketing (competitive intelligence management), and technical support (product lookups). As of this enrichment pass Relatable publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, docs portal, or SDKs.

companies.name: Datalogue
companies.description: Datalogue was a self-service data integration and preparation startup founded in 2015 that used machine learning to automatically classify, transform, and standardize data from disparate sources for analytics teams. Backed by Bloomberg Beta, the company was acquired by Nike in February 2019 and its standalone product was discontinued; the datalogue.io domain now serves an unrelated blog. This profile is retained for the API Evangelist network as a historical/portfolio record. The only surviving first-party developer artifacts are the company's public GitHub organization and an unmaintained Python SDK ("datalogue") still published on PyPI.

companies.name: DataSift (MediaSift Inc.)
companies.description: DataSift (MediaSift Inc.) was a pioneering social data platform that provided real-time and historical access to social media firehoses (Twitter, Facebook Topic Data, and more) through its CSDL filtering language and its Push, Historics, and Managed Sources REST APIs. Founded in 2007 and backed by Insight Partners and others, the company was acquired by Meltwater in 2019; the datasift.com domain now redirects to meltwater.com and the standalone DataSift developer platform and APIs have been discontinued. Official first-party client SDKs for Python, Ruby, PHP, Java, and Node.js remain published on public package registries under the datasift GitHub organization as historical artifacts.

companies.name: Eneryield
companies.description: Eneryield is a Gothenburg, Sweden based company (a Techstars portfolio company) building AI-powered fault prediction and analytics for electric power systems. Its flagship product, Eneryield IntelliView, uses explainable AI to forecast power outages before they occur by analyzing voltage and current signals from digital relays and merging units on overhead lines, underground cables, and underwater cables. The cloud-based platform integrates directly into existing utility monitoring systems without additional hardware, giving grid operators transparent root-cause analysis so they can move to proactive maintenance and reduce operational cost and downtime. As of this profile, Eneryield publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this record captures its identity and infrastructure posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Impira
companies.description: Impira was a document-AI / intelligent-document-processing company that let business users turn unstructured content — documents, invoices, images, PDFs and webpages — into structured, queryable data by building and training extraction models without code. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Impira was acquired by Figma in early 2023 and its standalone product domains (impira.com, impira.io) no longer serve. Its GitHub organization (github.com/impira) survives, along with two first-party open-source Python libraries still published on PyPI: the official Impira Python SDK and DocQuery, an MIT-licensed document question-answering library. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as an acquired-company record; there is no live API, developer portal, or hosted documentation surface remaining.

companies.name: Interana
companies.description: Interana was an event-based behavioral analytics platform for interactively querying large-scale event data (clickstream, product usage, and time-series data) at full resolution. Founded around 2013 in Redwood City, California by former Facebook engineers, it was used at scale by companies including Microsoft Bing. The company's team and technology were acquired by Twitter in March 2020; the standalone product was spun out and continued as Scuba Analytics (scuba.io), and the interana.com domain now redirects to its successor lineage. This API Evangelist profile is retained as a historical / defunct company record — there is no live public API surface, developer portal, or hosted documentation remaining. The only surviving first-party developer surface is the open-source Interana GitHub organization.

companies.name: SigOpt
companies.description: SigOpt was a machine learning experimentation and optimization platform whose API applied ensemble Bayesian and black-box optimization to tune model hyperparameters, run design-of-experiments, and track experiment metadata at scale. Developers integrated its REST API and first-party clients (Python, Java, R, scikit-learn, Spark, MATLAB) to drive automated hyperparameter search from their training loops. SigOpt was acquired by Intel in 2020 and its hosted API and platform were subsequently discontinued; sigopt.com now redirects to an Intel corporate redirector and the api./app./docs.sigopt.com hosts no longer resolve. The GitHub organization (github.com/sigopt) and the published client libraries remain public as historical, first-party artifacts, including an open-sourced server and optimization engine (sigopt-server, sigoptlite, libsigopt).

companies.name: Tahoe Therapeutics
companies.description: Tahoe Therapeutics (formerly Vevo Therapeutics) is a South San Francisco digital-biology company building the "ground truth for biological superintelligence." Its Mosaic platform generates perturbative single-cell data in vivo at gigascale, and it trains AI models — including the Tahoe-x1 single-cell foundation model (up to 3 billion parameters) and the Rhaister family of perturbation-response models — on the resulting data to discover novel drug targets and predict how patient cells respond to drugs. Tahoe openly publishes datasets (including the 100-million-cell Tahoe-100M atlas) and model weights on Hugging Face, ships the tahoe-x1 Python package on PyPI, and operates Tara, an autonomous research agent. The company does not run a public REST API. Backed by Amplify Partners; raised $30M in 2025.

companies.name: Transform
companies.description: Transform (Transform Data) was a metrics-store and semantic-layer company backed by Redpoint Ventures that offered a metrics framework, a metrics catalog, and the MQL (Metrics Query Language) API, and open-sourced the MetricFlow metrics framework. Transform was acquired by dbt Labs (announced February 2023), and its technology lives on as MetricFlow and the dbt Semantic Layer. transform.co now returns a 308 Permanent Redirect to getdbt.com on every path, and the company no longer operates an independent API or developer surface — see the dbt provider profile in this network for the successor APIs.

companies.name: Uninstall
companies.description: Uninstall.io was a mobile "uninstall intelligence" platform built by Songline Analytics (Bengaluru/Singapore, founded 2015) whose iOS and Android SDKs tracked app uninstalls, surfaced uninstall reasons, and drove re-install campaigns for customers like Snapdeal, Axis Bank, Zalora, and BankBazaar. Backed by 500 Startups India, Rajan Anandan, and Hive Data, it was acquired by Singapore healthtech company Mobile Health in July 2018. The uninstall.io domain is now parked for sale and no public API surface remains; the GitHub organization and first-party mobile SDKs survive as the public footprint.

companies.name: Varada
companies.description: Varada was a Tel Aviv-based data lake analytics accelerator that used proprietary, patented adaptive indexing to dramatically speed up Trino/Presto queries directly on data lake storage. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Varada was acquired by Starburst Data on June 23, 2022, and its indexing technology and engineering team were folded into Starburst's query engine. The company published developer tooling (the vtm cluster-management CLI, a Presto/Trino workload analyzer, and a PowerBI Presto connector) on GitHub but no public API; the varada.io domain is now parked and its GitHub organization has been dormant since the acquisition.

companies.name: Basecamp Research
companies.description: Basecamp Research is a London-based biotech company mapping global genetic biodiversity to power AI-based design of biological systems. Its core asset is BaseGraph, a Neo4j-backed knowledge graph of billions of biological relationships assembled from novel protein and genome sequences collected under access-and-benefit-sharing partnerships with biodiversity-rich countries. On top of this data it builds foundation models and tools including EDEN (a large-scale biology sequence model), BaseFold (3D protein structure prediction that improves on AlphaFold2 for large, complex structures and small-molecule interactions), and BaseScan (an automated annotation pipeline). Basecamp works with pharma and biotech partners on drug discovery and enzyme/protein design, and has collaborated with NVIDIA to bring BaseFold to the BioNeMo platform. Backed by True Ventures. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Basecamp Research currently exposes no public self-serve developer API - data and models are accessed via partnerships, and product docs sit behind an authenticated portal.

companies.name: Bizible Marketing Analytics
companies.description: Bizible was a B2B marketing attribution and revenue analytics platform that connected marketing activity to pipeline and revenue across advertising, web, CRM, and marketing-automation channels. Acquired by Marketo in 2018 and subsequently by Adobe, the product now ships as Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly Bizible); the bizible.com domain 301-redirects to Adobe and its product documentation has moved to the Adobe Experience League. It has no standalone public developer portal, OpenAPI, or API reference of its own — integration is handled through Adobe/Marketo Measure and CRM connectors.

companies.name: JDBC
companies.description: JDBC (Java Database Connectivity) is a Java API that defines how a client may access a database. It provides methods for querying and updating data in a database and is oriented towards relational databases. JDBC is part of the Java Standard Edition platform via the java.sql module (with enterprise extensions in javax.sql), and every JDBC driver implements the Driver interface to enable database connectivity in Java applications.

companies.name: Osmos
companies.description: Osmos is an AI-powered data ingestion and data onboarding platform that helps companies import, clean, transform, and validate data arriving from customers, partners, and third-party sources. Its core products include the Osmos Uploader, an embeddable data-import experience that lets end users upload spreadsheets and CSV files that are automatically mapped, validated, and cleaned; AI Data Wrangler capabilities that use AI agents to reshape messy inbound data into a target schema; and data pipelines for recurring ingestion from files, APIs, and other systems. Osmos is aimed at product and data teams that need to reliably onboard external data without building and maintaining bespoke import tooling. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and enriched through the enrichment pipeline; public API surface details are gated behind the Osmos application and documentation.

companies.name: Moven
companies.description: Moven (Movencorp Newco Inc.) is a New York City fintech founded in 2011 by Brett King and Alex Sion. Originally a direct-to-consumer mobile banking and financial-wellness app, the company pivoted in 2020 to a business-to-business model, licensing its spending-analytics and financial-wellness technology to banks, credit unions, and other fintechs through open APIs and SDKs. Its data-driven engagement modules power companion and challenger-bank experiences such as TD Bank's MySpend and Westpac's CashNav. Moven's API and SDK surface is partner-gated behind a demo/sandbox request rather than a self-serve public developer portal, so no public OpenAPI, reference documentation, or GitHub organization is available for catalog harvesting.

companies.name: Vancity
companies.description: Vancity (Vancouver City Savings Credit Union) is a member-owned financial co-operative headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, and the largest community credit union in Canada, with over 543,000 members, roughly CA$35 billion in assets, and about 60 branches across the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island. Founded in 1946 as an open-bond credit union, it is provincially chartered and cooperatively governed, offering retail and business banking, mortgages, foreign exchange, Visa cards, insurance, and investment advice, with values-based and impact-lending positioning. Vancity exposes no first-party public developer API portal: developer.vancity.com and developers.vancity.com do not resolve. It participates in Canada's shared payment rails through Central 1 (its banking-technology and payments provider, including enhanced Interac e-Transfer real-time payments) and Payments Canada, while third-party consumer data access is provided through aggregators such as Plaid and Flinks. Canada's federal Consumer-Driven Banking (open banking) framework is legislated but not yet operational, so any programmatic account access today is voluntary and aggregator-mediated rather than served by a documented Vancity API.

companies.name: Bitacora.io
companies.description: Bitacora.io is a Mexican field-data and operations platform (a 500 Global / 500 LatAm Batch 14 startup) that helps deskless teams in construction, maintenance, and field services capture reports, photos, tasks, and events from the field. Its mobile and web apps work offline and sync to the cloud when connectivity returns, turning field activity into searchable records, PDF and Excel exports, map and gallery views, and real-time analytics dashboards for managers. Bitacora is a SaaS product rather than a developer-API company - it offers custom development, integrations, and KPI dashboards as professional services, but does not publish a public self-serve API, OpenAPI specification, or SDK.

companies.name: Eigen
companies.description: Eigen Technologies is a London-based intelligent document processing (IDP) and data-extraction company that uses natural language processing, object detection and machine learning to extract, classify and interpret structured data from unstructured documents at scale. Its no-code platform lets teams in financial services, insurance, law and professional services pull hundreds of datapoints out of contracts, loan agreements and filings to manage risk, automate processes and meet regulatory obligations, with extracted data pushed downstream via its document-processing API. Founded in 2014 and backed by Goldman Sachs, Temasek, Lakestar, Dawn Capital, ING Ventures, Anthemis and the Sony Innovation Fund, Eigen was acquired by contract-lifecycle-management platform Sirion in June 2024.

companies.name: INTL FCStone
companies.description: INTL FCStone Inc. (rebranded as StoneX Group in 2020) is a Fortune 100 financial services organization providing execution, risk management, advisory services, market intelligence, and post-trade services across asset classes and global markets including commodities, equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, and securities.

companies.name: IQVIA
companies.description: IQVIA empowers life sciences organizations to accelerate innovation, improve patient outcomes, and bring treatments to market faster through advanced analytics and technology. IQVIA is a Fortune 500 company offering data, analytics, clinical research, and connected intelligence services.

companies.name: 1yongcloud
companies.description: Beijing Yiyong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京壹永科技有限公司 / 1yongcloud), founded in October 2017, is a Chinese oncology big-data and artificial-intelligence company. It builds medical-data collection, quality-control and governance capabilities and healthcare information products for hospitals and government health programs. Its product lines include a tumor diagnosis-and-treatment standardization and cost-rationalization platform, a hospital cancer opportunistic-screening platform, an integrated clinical-research platform, and a smart-hospital comprehensive operations decision platform. The company is backed by investors including Qiming Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital China, and Cathay Capital. It operates no public developer portal, API, or SDK; this profile tracks 1yongcloud as a company in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: AkashX
companies.description: AkashX is a Techstars-backed data and AI company building an Online Cognitive Processing (OLCP) Database and a declarative "Cognitive SQL" engine for reasoning over structured and unstructured data at scale. Its platform runs small language models in-database to deliver low-latency, token-efficient, deterministic inference as an alternative to probabilistic RAG, with semantic operations such as Cognitive Join, Cognitive Classify, and Cognitive Topic Discovery, plus Ontology Views that turn files into queryable tables for agents. It integrates with lakehouse environments like Databricks and targets financial intelligence, sales analysis, healthcare and clinical-trial, and talent-screening use cases. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation is published yet.

companies.name: Alooma
companies.description: Alooma was a cloud data-pipeline (ETL) platform founded in 2013 in Palo Alto and Tel Aviv that let enterprises stream and migrate data from sources such as SQL Server, Oracle, Amazon Aurora, Salesforce, Zendesk, and Zuora into data warehouses including Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, and Snowflake. It offered a hosted pipeline with a REST API input connector and a first-party Python client (alooma.py) for programmatic management of inputs, mappings, and tables. Google Cloud acquired Alooma in February 2019 and wound the standalone product down; the alooma.com developer surface no longer resolves. This profile is retained as a historical/acquired-company record surfaced from the Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio.

companies.name: Carnot Innovations
companies.description: Carnot Innovations is a Hong Kong-based building energy management company that applies AI, machine learning, and advanced data analytics to optimize HVAC systems and reduce energy consumption across commercial buildings, data centers, hospitals, railways, and sewage treatment facilities in the Asia-Pacific region. Its platform delivers AI-driven energy optimization, predictive maintenance and fault detection for chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and air handling units, analytics dashboards for facility managers, and continuous commissioning insights, reporting outcomes such as 15% energy cost reductions, 90% hidden-fault detection, and 15 million kWh per year of energy savings across its deployment portfolio. It is a portfolio company of 500 Global. Carnot Innovations does not currently publish a public developer program or API; this profile exists in the API Evangelist network for discovery and enrichment.

companies.name: Ekomoditi
companies.description: eKomoditi (PT Ekomoditi Solutions Indonesia) is a Southeast Asian agriculture-technology company, founded in 2015 and based in Jakarta, that builds digital plantation-management software for oil palm, rubber, sugar, and durian estates. Its flagship Electronic Plantation Control System (ePCS) replaces paper-based field recording with a mobile in-field Android app, an eGIS geographic mapping application, mills automation, and business-intelligence analytics — capturing harvesting, fertilization, pest-management, worker, and transport data for same-day reporting, labor-fraud monitoring, quality control, and traceability. eKomoditi also offers aerial-mapping drone services, a plantation marketplace, and due-diligence consulting. The company is backed by 500 Global and ZB Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: Governata
companies.description: Governata is a Saudi Arabia-based data governance and management platform that helps government entities and enterprises turn complex data into business value through comprehensive, PDPL-aligned data management. Its product suite spans Data Governance (business glossary, data catalog, data classification, data lineage, metadata store, data quality), Master Data Management (domains, golden record, matching and survivorship), Data Privacy (personal-data discovery and protection under Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law, access management, and a service catalog), and Governata Core, an administrative backbone covering license management, audit trail, and workflows. Governata packages role-based solutions for chief data officers, compliance officers, data protection officers, and data stewards, and sector solutions for government, healthcare, financial services, insurance, telecom, retail, energy, and large enterprises. It is backed by 500 Global and is being profiled in the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification was found at the time of enrichment; this profile captures the company's identity and web presence.

companies.name: GreenQ
companies.description: GreenQ is an Israeli smart waste-management technology company (founded 2015, Jerusalem) promoting the "Internet of Garbage" — turning ordinary garbage trucks into smart trucks. Its GreenTrack device installs on any collection vehicle to weigh incoming waste and track route, mileage, capacity, time and per-bin (single-can-level) pickup data without requiring sensors on the bins, using a patent-pending visual-recognition algorithm. A recommendations engine then suggests route-optimization and scheduling improvements, surfaced through the GreenQ dashboard of reports and analytics. Collected data can be integrated with a municipality's local-authority systems through a private integration API; the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or specification.
